// ==UserScript==
// @name         YouTube Music - Classic Winamp 2.95 + AVS + Dockable Windows (4x Ultra HD)
// @namespace    https://music.youtube.com/
// @version      2.95.6
// @description  YouTube Music için 4x Ultra HD klasik Winamp 2.95, 12 efektli AVS Visualization penceresi, şarkı geçişlerinde efekt içi başlık animasyonu, tam Türkçe ipucu açıklamaları (Tooltips), ayrılıp birleşebilen pencereler ve tam çerçevesiz masaüstü taşıma modu.
// @author       Winamp YTM Bridge
// @match        https://music.youtube.com/*
// @run-at       document-idle
// @grant        none
// ==/UserScript==

(function () {
  'use strict';

  if (window.__WINAMP_YTM_LOADED__) return;
  window.__WINAMP_YTM_LOADED__ = true;

  // Orijinal Winamp 2.95 (winamp.exe) içerisinden çıkartılmış klasik skin sprite kaynakları
  const SPRITES = {
  "MAIN": "data:image/png;base64,",
  "CBUTTONS": "data:image/png;base64,",
  "MONOSTER": "data:image/png;base64,",
  "PLAYPAUS": "data:image/png;base64,",
  "SHUFREP": "data:image/png;base64,",
  "NUMBERS": "data:image/png;base64,",
  "VOLUME": "data:image/png;base64,",
  "TEXT": "data:image/png;base64,",
  "POSBAR": "data:image/png;base64,",
  "TITLEBAR": "data:image/png;base64,",
  "EQMAIN": "data:image/png;base64,",
  "BALANCE": "data:image/png;base64,",
  "PLEDIT": "data:image/png;base64,",
  "PLEDIT_BG": "data:image/png;base64,",
  "GEN": "data:image/png;base64,"
};

  function safeGet(key, fallback) {
    try {
      const v = window.localStorage.getItem(key);
      return v !== null ? v : fallback;
    } catch (e) {
      return fallback;
    }
  }

  // Pencere ve Oynatıcı Durumu
  const STATE = {
    uiScale: parseFloat(safeGet('wa_ytm_uiscale', '1.3')) || 1.3,
    // Ana Pencere (MAIN - 275x116)
    wx: parseInt(safeGet('wa_ytm_wx', '30'), 10),
    wy: parseInt(safeGet('wa_ytm_wy', '50'), 10),
    windowshade: safeGet('wa_ytm_wshade', '0') === '1',

    // Playlist Penceresi (PLAYLIST)
    plOpen: safeGet('wa_ytm_plopen', '1') !== '0',
    plX: parseInt(safeGet('wa_ytm_plx', '30'), 10),
    plY: parseInt(safeGet('wa_ytm_ply', '201'), 10),
    plWidth: parseInt(safeGet('wa_ytm_plw', '275'), 10) || 275,
    plHeight: parseInt(safeGet('wa_ytm_plh', '262'), 10) || 262,
    plWindowshade: safeGet('wa_ytm_plwshade', '0') === '1',
    plDocked: safeGet('wa_ytm_pldocked', '1') !== '0',

    // AVS Visualization Penceresi (AVS)
    avsOpen: safeGet('wa_ytm_avsopen', '1') !== '0',
    avsX: parseInt(safeGet('wa_ytm_avsx', '-1'), 10),
    avsY: parseInt(safeGet('wa_ytm_avsy', '-1'), 10),
    avsWidth: parseInt(safeGet('wa_ytm_avsw', '275'), 10) || 275,
    avsHeight: parseInt(safeGet('wa_ytm_avsh', '185'), 10) || 185,
    avsWindowshade: safeGet('wa_ytm_avswshade', '0') === '1',
    avsDocked: safeGet('wa_ytm_avsdocked', '1') !== '0',
    avsDockSide: safeGet('wa_ytm_avsdockside', 'right'), // 'right' | 'left' | 'bottom'
    avsPreset: parseInt(safeGet('wa_ytm_avspreset', '0'), 10) || 0,
    avsAutoCycle: safeGet('wa_ytm_avsauto', '0') === '1',
    avsLastCycleTime: 0,
    avsPresetLabelUntil: 0,

    // Şarkı başladığında / durduğunda / değiştiğinde AVS efektleri arasında görünüp kaybolan başlık animasyonu
    avsTitleAnim: {
      text: '',
      subText: '',
      startTime: 0,
      duration: 3800
    },

    // Equalizer Penceresi (EQ)
    eqOpen: safeGet('wa_ytm_eqopen', '0') === '1',
    eqX: parseInt(safeGet('wa_ytm_eqx', '30'), 10),
    eqY: parseInt(safeGet('wa_ytm_eqy', '542'), 10),
    eqDocked: safeGet('wa_ytm_eqdocked', '1') !== '0',

    // Oynatma ve Ses Durumu
    timeleftmode: parseInt(safeGet('wa_ytm_timeleftmode', '1'), 10),
    saMode: parseInt(safeGet('wa_ytm_samode', '1'), 10), // 0..6 (6 farklı mini görselleştirici modu + Kapalı)
    activeWindow: 'main',
    playing: false,
    paused: false,
    stopped: true,
    lastPlayingState: null,
    lastSongBannerKey: '',
    currentTime: 0,
    duration: 0,
    volume: 180,
    pan: 0,
    shuffle: false,
    repeat: false,
    eqEnabled: false,
    eqAuto: false,
    preamp: 31,
    eqBands: [31, 31, 31, 31, 31, 31, 31, 31, 31, 31],
    kbps: 128,
    khz: 44,
    marqueeText: 'WINAMP 2.95 - YOUTUBE MUSIC READY *** ',
    overrideText: '',
    overrideUntil: 0,
    marqueeOffset: 0,
    lastMarqueeTick: 0,
    pressedBtn: null,
    draggingAction: null,
    dragPosRatio: 0,
    tracks: [],
    currentIndex: -1,
    selectedIndex: -1,
    selectedIndices: new Set(),
    scrollOffset: 0,
    visibleRows: 15,
    activePopup: null,
    saBars: new Float32Array(19),
    saPeaks: new Float32Array(19),
    saPeakHold: new Int32Array(19),
    oscData: new Float32Array(76),
    popoutWin: null
  };

  STATE.uiScale = Math.max(0.85, Math.min(2.6, STATE.uiScale));
  STATE.plWidth = Math.max(275, Math.min(580, STATE.plWidth));
  STATE.plHeight = Math.max(154, Math.min(680, STATE.plHeight));
  STATE.avsWidth = Math.max(220, Math.min(580, STATE.avsWidth));
  STATE.avsHeight = Math.max(140, Math.min(500, STATE.avsHeight));

  // Şarkı başladığında, durduğunda veya değiştiğinde AVS içinde başlığı efektler arasında gösterip kaybet
  function triggerAvsSongTransition(statusBadge, songTitle) {
    const cleanSong = String(songTitle || '').trim();
    if (!cleanSong) return;
    STATE.avsTitleAnim = {
      text: cleanSong,
      subText: statusBadge || '♪ ŞİMDİ ÇALIYOR',
      startTime: performance.now(),
      duration: 4200
    };
  }

  // =========================================================================
  // 4X ULTRA HD ALGORİTMASI: SCALE2X/EPX (1x -> 2x -> 4x) + HD VEKTÖR KATMANI
  // =========================================================================
  function scale2xImageData(srcData, w, h) {
    const dstW = w * 2;
    const dstH = h * 2;
    const src = new Uint32Array(srcData.data.buffer);
    const dstBuf = new ArrayBuffer(dstW * dstH * 4);
    const dst = new Uint32Array(dstBuf);

    for (let y = 0; y < h; y++) {
      const ym1 = y > 0 ? y - 1 : 0;
      const yp1 = y < h - 1 ? y + 1 : h - 1;
      for (let x = 0; x < w; x++) {
        const xm1 = x > 0 ? x - 1 : 0;
        const xp1 = x < w - 1 ? x + 1 : w - 1;

        const P = src[y * w + x];
        const A = src[ym1 * w + x];
        const B = src[y * w + xp1];
        const C = src[y * w + xm1];
        const D = src[yp1 * w + x];

        let E0 = P, E1 = P, E2 = P, E3 = P;
        if (C !== B && A !== D) {
          if (C === A) E0 = A;
          if (A === B) E1 = B;
          if (C === D) E2 = C;
          if (B === D) E3 = D;
        }

        const dx = x * 2;
        const dy = y * 2;
        dst[dy * dstW + dx] = E0;
        dst[dy * dstW + dx + 1] = E1;
        dst[(dy + 1) * dstW + dx] = E2;
        dst[(dy + 1) * dstW + dx + 1] = E3;
      }
    }
    return new ImageData(new Uint8ClampedArray(dstBuf), dstW, dstH);
  }

  const UP = 4;
  const IMG = {};
  let imagesLoaded = 0;
  const spriteKeys = Object.keys(SPRITES);

  spriteKeys.forEach((k) => {
    const im = new Image();
    im.onload = () => {
      const c1 = document.createElement('canvas');
      c1.width = im.width;
      c1.height = im.height;
      const ctx1 = c1.getContext('2d');
      ctx1.drawImage(im, 0, 0);
      const id1 = ctx1.getImageData(0, 0, im.width, im.height);
      const id2 = scale2xImageData(id1, im.width, im.height);
      const id4 = scale2xImageData(id2, im.width * 2, im.height * 2);

      const c4 = document.createElement('canvas');
      c4.width = im.width * UP;
      c4.height = im.height * UP;
      c4.getContext('2d').putImageData(id4, 0, 0);
      c4.complete = true;
      IMG[k] = c4;

      imagesLoaded++;
      if (imagesLoaded === spriteKeys.length) {
        syncDockedPositions();
        clampAllWindowsToViewport();
        applyGeometryAndScale();
        renderAll();
      }
    };
    im.src = SPRITES[k];
  });

  function drawSprite(ctx, img, sx, sy, sw, sh, dx, dy, dw, dh) {
    if (!img || !img.complete) return;
    if (arguments.length === 4) {
      const destX = sx, destY = sy;
      const w = img.width / UP, h = img.height / UP;
      ctx.drawImage(img, 0, 0, img.width, img.height, destX, destY, w, h);
      return;
    }
    ctx.drawImage(img, sx * UP, sy * UP, sw * UP, sh * UP, dx, dy, dw, dh);
  }

  // 4x Ultra HD Kayan Yazı ve Dijital Font Çizici
  function drawTextBmp(ctx, text, dx, dy, maxChars, pixelOffset = 0, clipWidth = 0) {
    const upper = String(text || '').toUpperCase();
    ctx.save();
    if (clipWidth > 0) {
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.rect(dx, dy, clipWidth, 6.5);
      ctx.clip();
    }
    ctx.fillStyle = '#000000';
    ctx.fillRect(dx, dy, clipWidth || (maxChars || upper.length) * 5, 6);

    ctx.font = 'bold 6.2px "Courier New", Consolas, monospace';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'top';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#00FF00';

    const totalChars = maxChars || upper.length;
    for (let i = 0; i < totalChars; i++) {
      const ch = upper[i] || ' ';
      if (ch === ' ') continue;
      const cx = dx + i * 5 - pixelOffset;
      if (clipWidth > 0 && (cx + 5 < dx || cx > dx + clipWidth)) continue;
      ctx.fillText(ch, cx + 0.2, dy - 0.3);
    }
    ctx.restore();
  }

  // 4x Ultra HD 7-Segment Yeşil LCD Rakam Çizici
  function drawHDSevenSegmentDigit(ctx, digit, dx, dy) {
    ctx.fillStyle = '#002200';
    for (let py = 1; py < 12; py += 2) {
      for (let px = 1; px < 8; px += 2) {
        ctx.fillRect(dx + px, dy + py, 1, 1);
      }
    }
    if (digit === null || digit === undefined || digit < 0) return;

    const segs = {
      0: [1, 1, 1, 0, 1, 1, 1],
      1: [0, 0, 1, 0, 0, 1, 0],
      2: [1, 0, 1, 1, 1, 0, 1],
      3: [1, 0, 1, 1, 0, 1, 1],
      4: [0, 1, 1, 1, 0, 1, 0],
      5: [1, 1, 0, 1, 0, 1, 1],
      6: [1, 1, 0, 1, 1, 1, 1],
      7: [1, 0, 1, 0, 0, 1, 0],
      8: [1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1],
      9: [1, 1, 1, 1, 0, 1, 1]
    }[digit];
    if (!segs) return;

    ctx.fillStyle = '#00FF00';
    if (segs[0]) ctx.fillRect(dx + 1.5, dy + 0.5, 6, 1.35);
    if (segs[1]) ctx.fillRect(dx + 0.5, dy + 1.5, 1.35, 4.5);
    if (segs[2]) ctx.fillRect(dx + 7.15, dy + 1.5, 1.35, 4.5);
    if (segs[3]) ctx.fillRect(dx + 1.5, dy + 5.8, 6, 1.35);
    if (segs[4]) ctx.fillRect(dx + 0.5, dy + 6.9, 1.35, 4.6);
    if (segs[5]) ctx.fillRect(dx + 7.15, dy + 6.9, 1.35, 4.6);
    if (segs[6]) ctx.fillRect(dx + 1.5, dy + 11.2, 6, 1.35);
  }

  function drawHDTitlebarText(ctx, label, centerX, dy, bgWidth) {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#191926';
    ctx.fillRect(centerX - bgWidth / 2, dy, bgWidth, 9);
    ctx.font = 'bold 7.2px Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#000000';
    ctx.fillText(label, centerX + 0.5, dy + 5.2);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#E6E6EE';
    ctx.fillText(label, centerX, dy + 4.7);
    ctx.restore();
  }

  // Web Audio API (10-Band EQ + Stereo Balance + Gerçek Zamanlı Spektrum Analizörü)
  let audioCtx = null;
  let audioSource = null;
  let preampNode = null;
  let eqNodes = [];
  let pannerNode = null;
  let analyserNode = null;
  let hookedVideo = null;
  let audioHookFailed = false;

  const EQ_FREQS = [60, 170, 310, 600, 1000, 3000, 6000, 12000, 14000, 16000];

  function ensureAudioGraph(videoEl) {
    if (!videoEl || audioHookFailed) return;
    if (hookedVideo === videoEl && audioCtx) {
      if (audioCtx.state === 'suspended') audioCtx.resume().catch(() => {});
      return;
    }
    try {
      const AC = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
      if (!AC) return;
      if (!audioCtx) audioCtx = new AC();
      if (audioSource) {
        try { audioSource.disconnect(); } catch (e) {}
      }
      audioSource = audioCtx.createMediaElementSource(videoEl);
      preampNode = audioCtx.createGain();
      eqNodes = EQ_FREQS.map((freq, idx) => {
        const f = audioCtx.createBiquadFilter();
        f.type = idx === 0 ? 'lowshelf' : (idx === EQ_FREQS.length - 1 ? 'highshelf' : 'peaking');
        f.frequency.value = freq;
        f.Q.value = 1.4;
        f.gain.value = 0;
        return f;
      });
      pannerNode = audioCtx.createStereoPanner ? audioCtx.createStereoPanner() : null;
      analyserNode = audioCtx.createAnalyser();
      analyserNode.fftSize = 256;
      analyserNode.smoothingTimeConstant = 0.72;

      let curr = audioSource;
      curr.connect(preampNode);
      curr = preampNode;
      eqNodes.forEach((n) => {
        curr.connect(n);
        curr = n;
      });
      if (pannerNode) {
        curr.connect(pannerNode);
        curr = pannerNode;
      }
      curr.connect(analyserNode);
      analyserNode.connect(audioCtx.destination);
      hookedVideo = videoEl;
      updateAudioGraphParams();
    } catch (err) {
      audioHookFailed = true;
    }
  }

  function updateAudioGraphParams() {
    if (!audioCtx) return;
    if (preampNode) {
      const db = STATE.eqEnabled ? ((31 - STATE.preamp) / 31) * 12 : 0;
      preampNode.gain.value = Math.pow(10, db / 20);
    }
    eqNodes.forEach((node, idx) => {
      const val = STATE.eqBands[idx] ?? 31;
      node.gain.value = STATE.eqEnabled ? ((31 - val) / 31) * 12 : 0;
    });
    if (pannerNode) {
      pannerNode.pan.value = Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, STATE.pan / 127));
    }
  }

  // =========================================================================
  // STİL, PENCERELER VE KLASİK WINAMP TOOLTIP (AÇIKLAMA KUTUSU) SİSTEMİ
  // =========================================================================
  const CSS_TEXT = `
    .wa-win-floating {
      position: fixed;
      z-index: 2147483640;
      user-select: none;
      -webkit-user-select: none;
      font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;
      box-shadow: 0 6px 22px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.78);
      line-height: 1;
    }
    .wa-win-floating.wa-win-active {
      z-index: 2147483644;
    }
    .wa-win-floating canvas {
      display: block;
    }
    #wa-pledit-list {
      position: absolute;
      overflow: hidden;
      background: #000000;
      box-sizing: border-box;
      padding: 0;
    }
    .wa-pl-row {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      padding: 0 4px;
      font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;
      font-weight: 500;
      color: #00FF00;
      background: #000000;
      cursor: default;
      white-space: nowrap;
      overflow: hidden;
      box-sizing: border-box;
      -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
      text-rendering: geometricPrecision;
    }
    .wa-pl-row.wa-pl-current {
      color: #FFFFFF;
      font-weight: 600;
    }
    .wa-pl-row.wa-pl-selected {
      background: #0000C6;
      color: #FFFFFF;
    }
    .wa-pl-title {
      overflow: hidden;
      text-overflow: ellipsis;
      white-space: nowrap;
      flex: 1 1 auto;
      padding-right: 8px;
      pointer-events: none;
    }
    .wa-pl-dur {
      flex: 0 0 auto;
      text-align: right;
      font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
      pointer-events: none;
    }
    .wa-resize-handle {
      position: absolute;
      z-index: 40;
    }
    .wa-resize-se {
      right: 0;
      bottom: 0;
      width: 18px;
      height: 18px;
      cursor: nwse-resize;
    }
    .wa-resize-e {
      right: 0;
      top: 18px;
      bottom: 18px;
      width: 7px;
      cursor: ew-resize;
    }
    .wa-resize-s {
      left: 14px;
      right: 18px;
      bottom: 0;
      height: 7px;
      cursor: ns-resize;
    }
    #wa-jump-modal, #wa-avs-menu {
      position: absolute;
      left: 4.5%;
      top: 22px;
      width: 91%;
      height: 76%;
      background: #292939;
      border: 2px outset #7b7d94;
      z-index: 45;
      display: none;
      flex-direction: column;
      padding: 6px;
      box-sizing: border-box;
      color: #ffffff;
      font-size: 11px;
    }
    #wa-jump-input {
      width: 100%;
      box-sizing: border-box;
      background: #000000;
      color: #00FF00;
      border: 1px inset #555;
      padding: 4px 6px;
      font-family: Arial, sans-serif;
      font-size: 11px;
      margin-bottom: 5px;
      outline: none;
    }
    #wa-jump-results, #wa-avs-list {
      flex: 1;
      background: #000000;
      border: 1px inset #555;
      overflow-y: auto;
      color: #00FF00;
      font-size: 11px;
    }
    .wa-jump-item {
      padding: 3px 5px;
      cursor: pointer;
      white-space: nowrap;
      overflow: hidden;
      text-overflow: ellipsis;
    }
    .wa-jump-item:hover, .wa-jump-item.wa-active {
      background: #0000C6;
      color: #FFFFFF;
    }
    #wa-tooltip {
      position: fixed;
      z-index: 2147483647;
      background: #FFFFE1;
      color: #000000;
      border: 1px solid #000000;
      padding: 3px 6px;
      font-family: Tahoma, Arial, sans-serif;
      font-size: 11px;
      line-height: 1.25;
      pointer-events: none;
      white-space: nowrap;
      box-shadow: 2px 2px 5px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55);
      display: none;
    }
  `;

  const styleEl = document.createElement('style');
  styleEl.textContent = CSS_TEXT;
  document.head.appendChild(styleEl);

  const workspaceRoot = document.createElement('div');
  workspaceRoot.id = 'wa-workspace-root';
  document.body.appendChild(workspaceRoot);

  // Klasik Winamp Açıklama Kutusu (Tooltip)
  const tooltipEl = document.createElement('div');
  tooltipEl.id = 'wa-tooltip';
  workspaceRoot.appendChild(tooltipEl);

  let tooltipTimer = null;
  let lastTooltipText = '';

  function showWinampTooltip(text, clientX, clientY, targetCanvas) {
    if ( targetCanvas && targetCanvas.title !== text ) {
      targetCanvas.title = text || '';
    }
    if (!text) {
      lastTooltipText = '';
      if (tooltipTimer) clearTimeout(tooltipTimer);
      tooltipEl.style.display = 'none';
      return;
    }
    const activeDoc = (STATE.popoutWin && !STATE.popoutWin.closed) ? STATE.popoutWin.document : document;
    const vw = activeDoc.documentElement.clientWidth || window.innerWidth;
    const vh = activeDoc.documentElement.clientHeight || window.innerHeight;

    const placeTooltip = () => {
      tooltipEl.textContent = text;
      tooltipEl.style.display = 'block';
      const tw = tooltipEl.offsetWidth || 160;
      const th = tooltipEl.offsetHeight || 22;
      const tx = Math.max(4, Math.min(vw - tw - 6, clientX + 12));
      const ty = (clientY + 22 + th > vh) ? Math.max(4, clientY - th - 8) : (clientY + 20);
      tooltipEl.style.left = tx + 'px';
      tooltipEl.style.top = ty + 'px';
    };

    if (text !== lastTooltipText) {
      lastTooltipText = text;
      tooltipEl.style.display = 'none';
      if (tooltipTimer) clearTimeout(tooltipTimer);
      tooltipTimer = setTimeout(placeTooltip, 260);
    } else if (tooltipEl.style.display === 'block') {
      placeTooltip();
    }
  }

  // 1) Ana Winamp Penceresi (winMain) — Üstte ekstra metin rozeti YOKTUR, sol üst Winamp ikonu doğrudan işlev butonudur!
  const winMain = document.createElement('div');
  winMain.id = 'wa-win-main';
  winMain.className = 'wa-win-floating wa-win-active';
  const mainCanvas = document.createElement('canvas');
  winMain.appendChild(mainCanvas);
  const mainCtx = mainCanvas.getContext('2d');

  const mainResizeSE = document.createElement('div');
  mainResizeSE.className = 'wa-resize-handle wa-resize-se';
  mainResizeSE.title = 'Winamp Ölçeğini Büyüt / Küçült';
  winMain.appendChild(mainResizeSE);
  workspaceRoot.appendChild(winMain);

  // 2) Equalizer Penceresi (winEq)
  const winEq = document.createElement('div');
  winEq.id = 'wa-win-eq';
  winEq.className = 'wa-win-floating';
  const eqCanvas = document.createElement('canvas');
  winEq.appendChild(eqCanvas);
  const eqCtx = eqCanvas.getContext('2d');
  workspaceRoot.appendChild(winEq);

  // 3) Playlist Editor Penceresi (winPl)
  const winPl = document.createElement('div');
  winPl.id = 'wa-win-pl';
  winPl.className = 'wa-win-floating';
  const pleditCanvas = document.createElement('canvas');
  winPl.appendChild(pleditCanvas);
  const pleditCtx = pleditCanvas.getContext('2d');
  const pleditList = document.createElement('div');
  pleditList.id = 'wa-pledit-list';
  winPl.appendChild(pleditList);

  ['se', 'e', 's'].forEach((dir) => {
    const h = document.createElement('div');
    h.className = `wa-resize-handle wa-resize-${dir}`;
    h.dataset.resizeTarget = 'pl';
    h.dataset.resizeDir = dir;
    h.title = 'Çalma Listesi Penceresini Boyutlandır';
    winPl.appendChild(h);
  });

  // Jump to File (Şarkı Ara) modalı
  const jumpModal = document.createElement('div');

  // 4) AVS Visualization Penceresi (winAvs)
  const winAvs = document.createElement('div');

  // AVS Efekt Seçici Menü Modalı (Sağ tık veya sol üst AVS menüsü ile açılır)

  avsBufferCanvas.width = 520;
  avsBufferCanvas.height = 380;

  ['se', 'e', 's'].forEach((dir) => {
    const h = document.createElement('div');
    h.className = `wa-resize-handle wa-resize-${dir}`;
    h.dataset.resizeTarget = 'avs';
    h.dataset.resizeDir = dir;

  // =========================================================================
  // EKRAN SINIRLARINI AŞMAMA VE CHROME DIŞI TAM UYGULAMA PENCERESİ MODU
  // =========================================================================
  function getActiveViewport() {
    if (STATE.popoutWin && !STATE.popoutWin.closed) {
      return {
        w: STATE.popoutWin.innerWidth || 400,
        h: STATE.popoutWin.innerHeight || 500,
        isPopout: true
      };
    }
    return {
      w: document.documentElement.clientWidth || window.innerWidth,
      h: document.documentElement.clientHeight || window.innerHeight,
      isPopout: false
    };
  }

  // Hiçbir pencerenin ekran/pencere sınırlarını aşmamasını garanti eder
  function clampAllWindowsToViewport() {
    const vp = getActiveViewport();
    const s = STATE.uiScale;

    if (vp.isPopout) {
      // Masaüstü Pop-out penceresinde: Pencere komple Winamp uygulaması olur (sıfır boşluk, sıfır taşma!)
      STATE.wx = 0;
      STATE.wy = 0;
      const mainH = Math.round((STATE.windowshade ? 14 : 116) * s);
      const eqH = (!STATE.windowshade && STATE.eqOpen) ? Math.round(116 * s) : 0;
      const avsH = (!STATE.windowshade && STATE.avsOpen)
        ? Math.round((STATE.avsWindowshade ? 14 : STATE.avsHeight) * s)
        : 0;

      if (STATE.eqOpen) {
        STATE.eqX = 0;
        STATE.eqY = mainH;
      }
      if (STATE.plOpen) {
        STATE.plX = 0;
        STATE.plY = mainH + eqH;
        const availPlH = Math.max(154, Math.floor((vp.h - mainH - eqH - avsH) / s));
        if (!STATE.plWindowshade && availPlH >= 154) {
          STATE.plHeight = availPlH;
        }
      }
      if (STATE.avsOpen) {
        const plH = (!STATE.windowshade && STATE.plOpen)
          ? Math.round((STATE.plWindowshade ? 14 : STATE.plHeight) * s)
          : 0;
        STATE.avsX = 0;
        STATE.avsY = mainH + eqH + plH;
        STATE.avsWidth = STATE.plOpen ? STATE.plWidth : 275;
      }
      return;
    }

    const mainW = Math.round(275 * s);
    const mainH = Math.round((STATE.windowshade ? 14 : 116) * s);
    STATE.wx = Math.max(0, Math.min(Math.max(0, vp.w - mainW), STATE.wx));
    STATE.wy = Math.max(0, Math.min(Math.max(0, vp.h - mainH), STATE.wy));

    // Playlist ekran sınırlarını aşmasın
    const maxPlBaseW = Math.max(275, Math.floor((vp.w - STATE.plX) / s));
    if (STATE.plWidth > maxPlBaseW) STATE.plWidth = Math.max(275, maxPlBaseW);
    const plW = Math.round(STATE.plWidth * s);
    STATE.plX = Math.max(0, Math.min(Math.max(0, vp.w - plW), STATE.plX));

    if (!STATE.plWindowshade) {
      const maxPlBaseH = Math.max(154, Math.floor((vp.h - STATE.plY) / s));
      if (STATE.plHeight > maxPlBaseH) STATE.plHeight = Math.max(154, maxPlBaseH);
    }
    const plH = Math.round((STATE.plWindowshade ? 14 : STATE.plHeight) * s);
    STATE.plY = Math.max(0, Math.min(Math.max(0, vp.h - plH), STATE.plY));

    // EQ ekran sınırlarını aşmasın
    const eqW = Math.round(275 * s);
    const eqH = Math.round(116 * s);
    STATE.eqX = Math.max(0, Math.min(Math.max(0, vp.w - eqW), STATE.eqX));
    STATE.eqY = Math.max(0, Math.min(Math.max(0, vp.h - eqH), STATE.eqY));

    // AVS ekran sınırlarını aşmasın
    const avsW = Math.round(STATE.avsWidth * s);
    const avsH = Math.round((STATE.avsWindowshade ? 14 : STATE.avsHeight) * s);
    if (STATE.avsX < 0 || STATE.avsY < 0) {
      // İlk konumlandırma: Sağda yer varsa sağa, yoksa sola
      if (STATE.wx + mainW + avsW <= vp.w) {
        STATE.avsX = STATE.wx + mainW;
        STATE.avsY = STATE.wy;
        STATE.avsDockSide = 'right';
      } else if (STATE.wx - avsW >= 0) {
        STATE.avsX = STATE.wx - avsW;
        STATE.avsY = STATE.wy;
        STATE.avsDockSide = 'left';
      } else {
        STATE.avsX = STATE.wx;
        STATE.avsY = Math.min(vp.h - avsH, STATE.plY + plH);
        STATE.avsDockSide = 'bottom';
      }
    }
    STATE.avsX = Math.max(0, Math.min(Math.max(0, vp.w - avsW), STATE.avsX));
    STATE.avsY = Math.max(0, Math.min(Math.max(0, vp.h - avsH), STATE.avsY));
  }

  // Masaüstü Penceresi (Chrome Dışına Taşıma - Tam Sığdırma, Boşluksuz, Taşmasız)
  async function toggleExternalDesktopWindow() {
    if (STATE.popoutWin && !STATE.popoutWin.closed) {
      STATE.popoutWin.close();
      return;
    }

    const s = STATE.uiScale;
    const baseW = STATE.plOpen ? STATE.plWidth : 275;
    const mainH = STATE.windowshade ? 14 : 116;
    const eqH = (!STATE.windowshade && STATE.eqOpen) ? 116 : 0;
    const plH = (!STATE.windowshade && STATE.plOpen) ? (STATE.plWindowshade ? 14 : STATE.plHeight) : 0;
    const avsH = (!STATE.windowshade && STATE.avsOpen) ? (STATE.avsWindowshade ? 14 : STATE.avsHeight) : 0;

    const exactCssW = Math.round(baseW * s);
    const exactCssH = Math.round((mainH + eqH + plH + avsH) * s);

    try {
      let extWin = null;
      if ('documentPictureInPicture' in window) {
        extWin = await window.documentPictureInPicture.requestWindow({
          width: exactCssW,
          height: exactCssH,
          disallowReturnToOpener: true
        });
      } else {
        extWin = window.open('', 'WinampAppWindow', `popup=yes,width=${exactCssW},height=${exactCssH},left=100,top=80`);
      }

      if (!extWin) return;
      STATE.popoutWin = extWin;

      extWin.document.title = '\u200B'; // Boş görünmez başlık
      extWin.document.body.style.margin = '0';
      extWin.document.body.style.padding = '0';
      extWin.document.body.style.background = '#000000';
      extWin.document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';

      const extStyle = extWin.document.createElement('style');
      extStyle.textContent = CSS_TEXT + `
        .wa-win-floating { box-shadow: none !important; }
      `;
      extWin.document.head.appendChild(extStyle);

      const saved = {
        wx: STATE.wx, wy: STATE.wy,
        plX: STATE.plX, plY: STATE.plY, plW: STATE.plWidth, plH: STATE.plHeight,
        avsX: STATE.avsX, avsY: STATE.avsY, avsW: STATE.avsWidth, avsH: STATE.avsHeight,
        eqX: STATE.eqX, eqY: STATE.eqY,
        uiScale: STATE.uiScale
      };

      extWin.document.body.appendChild(workspaceRoot);

      // Pencere boyutu değiştiğinde Winamp'ı pencereye %100 sıfır boşlukla ve taşmadan oturt
      const fitPopoutWindow = () => {
        if (!STATE.popoutWin || STATE.popoutWin.closed) return;
        const pw = extWin.innerWidth || exactCssW;
        const ph = extWin.innerHeight || exactCssH;
        const targetBaseW = STATE.plOpen ? STATE.plWidth : 275;
        const mH = STATE.windowshade ? 14 : 116;
        const eH = (!STATE.windowshade && STATE.eqOpen) ? 116 : 0;
        const aH = (!STATE.windowshade && STATE.avsOpen) ? (STATE.avsWindowshade ? 14 : STATE.avsHeight) : 0;
        const minPlH = (!STATE.windowshade && STATE.plOpen) ? (STATE.plWindowshade ? 14 : 154) : 0;
        const minTotalBaseH = mH + eH + minPlH + aH;

        // Hem genişliğe hem yüksekliğe göre ölçeği sınırla ki asla pencereden taşmasın
        const scaleByW = pw / targetBaseW;
        const scaleByH = ph / Math.max(14, minTotalBaseH);
        STATE.uiScale = Math.max(0.65, Math.min(scaleByW, scaleByH));
        clampAllWindowsToViewport();
        applyGeometryAndScale();
        renderAll();
      };

      extWin.addEventListener('resize', fitPopoutWindow);
      fitPopoutWindow();

      const restoreBackToTab = () => {
        STATE.popoutWin = null;
        STATE.wx = saved.wx;
        STATE.wy = saved.wy;
        STATE.plX = saved.plX;
        STATE.plY = saved.plY;
        STATE.plWidth = saved.plW;
        STATE.plHeight = saved.plH;
        STATE.avsX = saved.avsX;
        STATE.avsY = saved.avsY;
        STATE.avsWidth = saved.avsW;
        STATE.avsHeight = saved.avsH;
        STATE.eqX = saved.eqX;
        STATE.eqY = saved.eqY;
        STATE.uiScale = saved.uiScale;
        document.body.appendChild(workspaceRoot);
        clampAllWindowsToViewport();
        applyGeometryAndScale();
        renderAll();
      };

      extWin.addEventListener('pagehide', restoreBackToTab);
      extWin.addEventListener('beforeunload', restoreBackToTab);
      attachWindowEvents(extWin);
    } catch (err) {
      setStatusOverride('MASAUSTU MODU ICIN SOL UST IKONA TIKLAYIN');
    }
  }

  // =========================================================================
  // MIKNATISLI KENETLENME (MAGNETIC SNAPPING & DOCKING) SİSTEMİ
  // =========================================================================
  function getMainRect() {
    const s = STATE.uiScale;
    const w = Math.round(275 * s);
    const h = Math.round((STATE.windowshade ? 14 : 116) * s);
    return { x: STATE.wx, y: STATE.wy, w, h, right: STATE.wx + w, bottom: STATE.wy + h };
  }

  function getEqRect() {
    const s = STATE.uiScale;
    const w = Math.round(275 * s);
    const h = Math.round(116 * s);
    return { x: STATE.eqX, y: STATE.eqY, w, h, right: STATE.eqX + w, bottom: STATE.eqY + h };
  }

  function getPlRect() {
    const s = STATE.uiScale;
    const w = Math.round(STATE.plWidth * s);
    const h = Math.round((STATE.plWindowshade ? 14 : STATE.plHeight) * s);
    return { x: STATE.plX, y: STATE.plY, w, h, right: STATE.plX + w, bottom: STATE.plY + h };
  }

  function getAvsRect() {
    const s = STATE.uiScale;
    const w = Math.round(STATE.avsWidth * s);
    const h = Math.round((STATE.avsWindowshade ? 14 : STATE.avsHeight) * s);
    return { x: STATE.avsX, y: STATE.avsY, w, h, right: STATE.avsX + w, bottom: STATE.avsY + h };
  }

  function syncDockedPositions() {
    if (STATE.popoutWin && !STATE.popoutWin.closed) {
      clampAllWindowsToViewport();
      return;
    }
    const vp = getActiveViewport();
    const m = getMainRect();
    if (STATE.eqDocked) {
      STATE.eqX = m.x;
      STATE.eqY = m.bottom;
    }
    const anchorBottom = (STATE.eqOpen && !STATE.windowshade && STATE.eqDocked)
      ? (m.bottom + Math.round(116 * STATE.uiScale))
      : m.bottom;

    if (STATE.plDocked) {
      STATE.plX = m.x;
      STATE.plY = anchorBottom;
    }
    if (STATE.avsDocked) {
      const avsW = Math.round(STATE.avsWidth * STATE.uiScale);
      if (STATE.avsDockSide === 'left' || (m.right + avsW > vp.w && m.x - avsW >= 0)) {
        STATE.avsX = m.x - avsW;
        STATE.avsY = m.y;
        STATE.avsDockSide = 'left';
      } else if (m.right + avsW <= vp.w) {
        STATE.avsX = m.right;
        STATE.avsY = m.y;
        STATE.avsDockSide = 'right';
      } else {
        const plR = getPlRect();
        STATE.avsX = m.x;
        STATE.avsY = STATE.plOpen ? plR.bottom : anchorBottom;
        STATE.avsDockSide = 'bottom';
      }
    }
  }

  function snapWindowToTargets(x, y, w, h, targets) {
    const SNAP = 14;
    let snappedX = x;
    let snappedY = y;
    let isDockedToMain = false;
    let dockSide = 'right';

    targets.forEach((t) => {
      if (Math.abs(x - t.x) < SNAP) snappedX = t.x;
      else if (Math.abs((x + w) - t.right) < SNAP) snappedX = t.right - w;
      else if (Math.abs(x - t.right) < SNAP) snappedX = t.right;
      else if (Math.abs((x + w) - t.x) < SNAP) snappedX = t.x - w;

      if (Math.abs(y - t.bottom) < SNAP) snappedY = t.bottom;
      else if (Math.abs((y + h) - t.y) < SNAP) snappedY = t.y - h;
      else if (Math.abs(y - t.y) < SNAP) snappedY = t.y;
      else if (Math.abs((y + h) - t.bottom) < SNAP) snappedY = t.bottom - h;
    });

    const m = getMainRect();
    if (Math.abs(snappedY - m.bottom) <= 3 && Math.abs(snappedX - m.x) <= 24) {
      isDockedToMain = true;
      dockSide = 'bottom';
    } else if (Math.abs(snappedX - m.right) <= 3 && Math.abs(snappedY - m.y) <= 24) {
      isDockedToMain = true;
      dockSide = 'right';
    } else if (Math.abs((snappedX + w) - m.x) <= 3 && Math.abs(snappedY - m.y) <= 24) {
      isDockedToMain = true;
      dockSide = 'left';
    }

    return { x: snappedX, y: snappedY, docked: isDockedToMain, dockSide };
  }

  function setupUltraHDCanvas(canvas, ctx, baseW, baseH) {
    const dpr = Math.max(2, Math.ceil(window.devicePixelRatio || 2));
    const cssW = Math.round(baseW * STATE.uiScale);
    const cssH = Math.round(baseH * STATE.uiScale);
    const internalScale = Math.max(4, Math.ceil(STATE.uiScale * dpr * 2));
    const targetW = baseW * internalScale;
    const targetH = baseH * internalScale;

    if (canvas.width !== targetW || canvas.height !== targetH) {
      canvas.width = targetW;
      canvas.height = targetH;
    }
    canvas.style.width = cssW + 'px';
    canvas.style.height = cssH + 'px';
    ctx.setTransform(internalScale, 0, 0, internalScale, 0, 0);
    ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled = false;
  }

  function applyGeometryAndScale() {
    clampAllWindowsToViewport();
    const s = STATE.uiScale;

    winMain.style.left = STATE.wx + 'px';
    winMain.style.top = STATE.wy + 'px';
    const mainBaseH = STATE.windowshade ? 14 : 116;
    setupUltraHDCanvas(mainCanvas, mainCtx, 275, mainBaseH);

    const hideSub = STATE.windowshade;

    winEq.style.display = (!hideSub && STATE.eqOpen) ? 'block' : 'none';
    if (!hideSub && STATE.eqOpen) {
      winEq.style.left = STATE.eqX + 'px';
      winEq.style.top = STATE.eqY + 'px';
      setupUltraHDCanvas(eqCanvas, eqCtx, 275, 116);
    }

    winPl.style.display = (!hideSub && STATE.plOpen) ? 'block' : 'none';
    if (!hideSub && STATE.plOpen) {
      winPl.style.left = STATE.plX + 'px';
      winPl.style.top = STATE.plY + 'px';
      const plBaseW = STATE.plWidth;
      const plBaseH = STATE.plWindowshade ? 14 : STATE.plHeight;
      winPl.style.width = Math.round(plBaseW * s) + 'px';
      winPl.style.height = Math.round(plBaseH * s) + 'px';
      setupUltraHDCanvas(pleditCanvas, pleditCtx, plBaseW, plBaseH);

      if (STATE.plWindowshade) {
        pleditList.style.display = 'none';
      } else {
        pleditList.style.display = 'block';
        pleditList.style.left = Math.round(12 * s) + 'px';
        pleditList.style.top = Math.round(20 * s) + 'px';
        pleditList.style.width = Math.round((plBaseW - 32) * s) + 'px';
        const listBaseH = plBaseH - 58;
        pleditList.style.height = Math.round(listBaseH * s) + 'px';
        STATE.visibleRows = Math.max(5, Math.floor(listBaseH / 13.55));
      }
    }

    winAvs.style.display = (!hideSub && STATE.avsOpen) ? 'block' : 'none';
    if (!hideSub && STATE.avsOpen) {
      winAvs.style.left = STATE.avsX + 'px';
      winAvs.style.top = STATE.avsY + 'px';
      const avsBaseW = STATE.avsWidth;
      const avsBaseH = STATE.avsWindowshade ? 14 : STATE.avsHeight;
      winAvs.style.width = Math.round(avsBaseW * s) + 'px';
      winAvs.style.height = Math.round(avsBaseH * s) + 'px';
      setupUltraHDCanvas(avsCanvas, avsCtx, avsBaseW, avsBaseH);
    }

    rebuildPlaylistDOM();
  }

  function setStatusOverride(msg, durationMs = 1200) {
    STATE.overrideText = msg;
    STATE.overrideUntil = performance.now() + durationMs;
    renderMain();
  }

  function saveState() {
    if (STATE.popoutWin && !STATE.popoutWin.closed) return;
    try {
      window.localStorage.setItem('wa_ytm_uiscale', STATE.uiScale.toFixed(3));
      window.localStorage.setItem('wa_ytm_wx', String(Math.round(STATE.wx)));
      window.localStorage.setItem('wa_ytm_wy', String(Math.round(STATE.wy)));
      window.localStorage.setItem('wa_ytm_wshade', STATE.windowshade ? '1' : '0');
      window.localStorage.setItem('wa_ytm_plopen', STATE.plOpen ? '1' : '0');
      window.localStorage.setItem('wa_ytm_plx', String(Math.round(STATE.plX)));
      window.localStorage.setItem('wa_ytm_ply', String(Math.round(STATE.plY)));
      window.localStorage.setItem('wa_ytm_plw', String(Math.round(STATE.plWidth)));
      window.localStorage.setItem('wa_ytm_plh', String(Math.round(STATE.plHeight)));
      window.localStorage.setItem('wa_ytm_plwshade', STATE.plWindowshade ? '1' : '0');
      window.localStorage.setItem('wa_ytm_pldocked', STATE.plDocked ? '1' : '0');
      window.localStorage.setItem('wa_ytm_avsopen', STATE.avsOpen ? '1' : '0');
      window.localStorage.setItem('wa_ytm_avsx', String(Math.round(STATE.avsX)));
      window.localStorage.setItem('wa_ytm_avsy', String(Math.round(STATE.avsY)));
      window.localStorage.setItem('wa_ytm_avsw', String(Math.round(STATE.avsWidth)));
      window.localStorage.setItem('wa_ytm_avsh', String(Math.round(STATE.avsHeight)));
      window.localStorage.setItem('wa_ytm_avswshade', STATE.avsWindowshade ? '1' : '0');
      window.localStorage.setItem('wa_ytm_avsdocked', STATE.avsDocked ? '1' : '0');
      window.localStorage.setItem('wa_ytm_avsdockside', STATE.avsDockSide);
      window.localStorage.setItem('wa_ytm_avspreset', String(STATE.avsPreset));
      window.localStorage.setItem('wa_ytm_avsauto', STATE.avsAutoCycle ? '1' : '0');
      window.localStorage.setItem('wa_ytm_eqopen', STATE.eqOpen ? '1' : '0');
      window.localStorage.setItem('wa_ytm_eqx', String(Math.round(STATE.eqX)));
      window.localStorage.setItem('wa_ytm_eqy', String(Math.round(STATE.eqY)));
      window.localStorage.setItem('wa_ytm_eqdocked', STATE.eqDocked ? '1' : '0');
      window.localStorage.setItem('wa_ytm_timeleftmode', String(STATE.timeleftmode));
      window.localStorage.setItem('wa_ytm_samode', String(STATE.saMode));
    } catch (e) {}
  }

  // =========================================================================
  // YOUTUBE MUSIC OYNATICI VE ÇALMA SIRASI (QUEUE) KÖPRÜSÜ
  // =========================================================================
  function getVideoEl() {
    return document.querySelector('video.html5-main-video') || document.querySelector('video');
  }

  function getMoviePlayer() {
    return document.getElementById('movie_player');
  }

  function formatTimeSec(sec) {
    if (!isFinite(sec) || sec < 0) sec = 0;
    const m = Math.floor(sec / 60);
    const s = Math.floor(sec % 60);
    return m + ':' + (s < 10 ? '0' + s : s);
  }

  function parseDurationSec(str) {
    if (!str) return 0;
    const parts = String(str).trim().split(':').map((p) => parseInt(p, 10));
    if (parts.some(isNaN)) return 0;
    if (parts.length === 3) return parts[0] * 3600 + parts[1] * 60 + parts[2];
    if (parts.length === 2) return parts[0] * 60 + parts[1];
    return parts[0] || 0;
  }

  function formatTotalTime(totalSec) {
    const h = Math.floor(totalSec / 3600);
    const m = Math.floor((totalSec % 3600) / 60);
    const s = Math.floor(totalSec % 60);
    const mm = h > 0 && m < 10 ? '0' + m : String(m);
    const ss = s < 10 ? '0' + s : String(s);
    return h > 0 ? `${h}:${mm}:${ss}` : `${m}:${ss}`;
  }

  function getCurrentSongLabel() {
    const tr = STATE.tracks[STATE.currentIndex];
    if (tr) return `${tr.index}. ${tr.display}`;
    const barTitle = document.querySelector('ytmusic-player-bar yt-formatted-string.title')?.textContent?.trim();
    const barArtist = document.querySelector('ytmusic-player-bar .byline-wrapper yt-formatted-string.byline')?.textContent?.trim();
    if (barTitle) return formatArtistAndTitle(barArtist, barTitle);
    return '';
  }

  function ytmPlay() {
    const v = getVideoEl();
    if (v && !v.paused && v.currentTime > 1) {
      v.currentTime = 0;
      v.play().catch(() => {});
      triggerAvsSongTransition('► BAŞTAN OYNATILIYOR', getCurrentSongLabel());
      return;
    }
    const mp = getMoviePlayer();
    if (mp && typeof mp.playVideo === 'function') {
      mp.playVideo();
      triggerAvsSongTransition('► OYNATILIYOR', getCurrentSongLabel());
      return;
    }
    if (v && v.paused) {
      v.play().catch(() => {});
      triggerAvsSongTransition('► OYNATILIYOR', getCurrentSongLabel());
      return;
    }
    const btn = document.querySelector('ytmusic-player-bar #play-pause-button, ytmusic-player-bar tp-yt-paper-icon-button.play-pause-button');
    if (btn) btn.click();
  }

  function ytmPause() {
    const v = getVideoEl();
    if (v) {
      if (v.paused) {
        v.play().catch(() => {});
        triggerAvsSongTransition('► DEVAM EDİYOR', getCurrentSongLabel());
      } else {
        v.pause();
        triggerAvsSongTransition('❚❚ DURAKLATILDI', getCurrentSongLabel());
      }
      return;
    }
    const btn = document.querySelector('ytmusic-player-bar #play-pause-button, ytmusic-player-bar tp-yt-paper-icon-button.play-pause-button');
    if (btn) btn.click();
  }

  function ytmStop() {
    const v = getVideoEl();
    if (v) {
      v.pause();
      v.currentTime = 0;
    }
    STATE.playing = false;
    STATE.paused = false;
    STATE.stopped = true;
    triggerAvsSongTransition('■ DURDURULDU', getCurrentSongLabel());
    renderMain();
  }

  function ytmPrev() {
    const btn = document.querySelector('ytmusic-player-bar .previous-button, ytmusic-player-bar tp-yt-paper-icon-button.previous-button');
    if (btn) {
      btn.click();
      return;
    }
    const mp = getMoviePlayer();
    if (mp && typeof mp.previousVideo === 'function') mp.previousVideo();
  }

  function ytmNext() {
    const btn = document.querySelector('ytmusic-player-bar .next-button, ytmusic-player-bar tp-yt-paper-icon-button.next-button');
    if (btn) {
      btn.click();
      return;
    }
    const mp = getMoviePlayer();
    if (mp && typeof mp.nextVideo === 'function') mp.nextVideo();
  }

  function ytmToggleShuffle() {
    const btn = document.querySelector(
      'ytmusic-player-bar .shuffle, ytmusic-player-bar tp-yt-paper-icon-button.shuffle, ytmusic-player-bar [aria-label*="Karıştır"], ytmusic-player-bar [aria-label*="Shuffle"]'
    );
    if (btn) btn.click();
    STATE.shuffle = !STATE.shuffle;
    setStatusOverride('SHUFFLE: ' + (STATE.shuffle ? 'ON' : 'OFF'));
  }

  function ytmToggleRepeat() {
    const btn = document.querySelector(
      'ytmusic-player-bar .repeat, ytmusic-player-bar tp-yt-paper-icon-button.repeat, ytmusic-player-bar [aria-label*="Tekrarla"], ytmusic-player-bar [aria-label*="Repeat"]'
    );
    if (btn) btn.click();
    STATE.repeat = !STATE.repeat;
    setStatusOverride('REPEAT: ' + (STATE.repeat ? 'ON' : 'OFF'));
  }

  function ytmSetVolume(vol255) {
    STATE.volume = Math.max(0, Math.min(255, Math.round(vol255)));
    const pct = Math.round((STATE.volume / 255) * 100);
    const v = getVideoEl();
    if (v) {
      v.volume = STATE.volume / 255;
      if (STATE.volume > 0 && v.muted) v.muted = false;
    }
    const mp = getMoviePlayer();
    if (mp && typeof mp.setVolume === 'function') {
      try { mp.setVolume(pct); } catch (e) {}
    }
    const slider = document.querySelector('ytmusic-player-bar #volume-slider, ytmusic-player-bar #expand-volume-slider');
    if (slider && 'value' in slider) {
      try { slider.value = pct; } catch (e) {}
    }
    setStatusOverride(`VOLUME: ${pct}%`);
  }

  function ytmSeekTo(seconds) {
    const v = getVideoEl();
    if (v && isFinite(seconds)) {
      v.currentTime = seconds;
    }
    const mp = getMoviePlayer();
    if (mp && typeof mp.seekTo === 'function') {
      try { mp.seekTo(seconds, true); } catch (e) {}
    }
  }

  function playQueueTrackAtIndex(idx) {
    const item = STATE.tracks[idx];
    if (!item) return;
    STATE.currentIndex = idx;
    STATE.selectedIndex = idx;
    updatePlaylistDOMSelection();
    triggerAvsSongTransition('► ŞARKI AÇILDI', `${item.index}. ${item.display}`);

    const targetEl = item.domEl && document.body.contains(item.domEl) ? item.domEl : null;

    if (targetEl) {
      const playBtn = targetEl.querySelector('ytmusic-play-button-renderer, #play-button, .left-items ytmusic-play-button-renderer');
      if (playBtn) {
        playBtn.click();
        return;
      }
      targetEl.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('dblclick', { bubbles: true, cancelable: true, view: window }));
      targetEl.click();
      return;
    }

    if (item.videoId) {
      const mp = getMoviePlayer();
      if (mp && typeof mp.loadVideoById === 'function') {
        try {
          mp.loadVideoById(item.videoId);
          return;
        } catch (e) {}
      }
    }
  }

  function formatArtistAndTitle(artist, title) {
    const cleanTitle = String(title || '').trim();
    const cleanArtist = String(artist || '').split('•')[0].trim();
    if (!cleanArtist) return cleanTitle;
    const lowerTitle = cleanTitle.toLowerCase();
    const lowerArtist = cleanArtist.toLowerCase();
    if (
      lowerTitle === lowerArtist ||
      lowerTitle.startsWith(lowerArtist + ' -') ||
      lowerTitle.startsWith(lowerArtist + '-') ||
      lowerTitle.startsWith(lowerArtist + ' –')
    ) {
      return cleanTitle;
    }
    const sep = cleanArtist.includes(' - ') ? '-' : ' - ';
    return `${cleanArtist}${sep}${cleanTitle}`;
  }

  function normalizeTrackSignature(artist, title) {
    const cleanStr = (s) => String(s || '')
      .toLowerCase()
      .replace(/\|.*$/g, '')
      .replace(/\(.*?\)|\[.*?\]/g, '')
      .replace(/official\s*(music\s*)?video|official\s*audio|lyric\s*video|visualizer|video\s*klip|resmi\s*video|hd|4k/gi, '')
      .replace(/\u0131/g, 'i')
      .replace(/i\u0307/g, 'i')
      .replace(/\u015f/g, 's')
      .replace(/\u011f/g, 'g')
      .replace(/\u00fc/g, 'u')
      .replace(/\u00f6/g, 'o')
      .replace(/\u00e7/g, 'c')
      .replace(/[\s\-_.,!?'":;\u2022/\\()\[\]{}+*&#@~^=<>$%]+/g, '');
    const a = cleanStr(String(artist || '').split('•')[0]);
    let t = cleanStr(title);
    if (a && t.startsWith(a) && t.length > a.length) {
      t = t.slice(a.length);
    }
    if (!t) t = String(title || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    return a + '|' + t;
  }

  let lastQueueSignature = '';

  function extractQueueFromYTM() {
    const extracted = [];
    let activeIdx = -1;

    const queueContainer = document.querySelector('ytmusic-player-queue#queue, ytmusic-player-queue');
    const rawQueueItems = (queueContainer && queueContainer.querySelectorAll('ytmusic-player-queue-item').length > 0)
      ? Array.from(queueContainer.querySelectorAll('ytmusic-player-queue-item'))
      : Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('ytmusic-player-queue-item'));

    if (rawQueueItems.length > 0) {
      const seenWrappers = new WeakSet();

      rawQueueItems.forEach((el) => {
        const wrapper = el.closest('ytmusic-playlist-panel-video-wrapper-renderer');

        const titleEl = el.querySelector('.song-title, yt-formatted-string.song-title, #song-title');
        const bylineEl = el.querySelector('.byline, yt-formatted-string.byline, #byline');
        const durEl = el.querySelector('.duration, yt-formatted-string.duration, #duration');

        let title = titleEl ? titleEl.textContent.trim() : '';
        let artist = bylineEl ? bylineEl.textContent.trim() : '';
        let durationStr = durEl ? durEl.textContent.trim() : '';
        let videoId = '';

        const rawData = el.data || (el.__data && el.__data.data) || (el.polymerController && el.polymerController.data);
        const d = rawData && (
          rawData.playlistPanelVideoRenderer ||
          (rawData.playlistPanelVideoWrapperRenderer &&
            rawData.playlistPanelVideoWrapperRenderer.primaryRenderer &&
            rawData.playlistPanelVideoWrapperRenderer.primaryRenderer.playlistPanelVideoRenderer) ||
          (rawData.title ? rawData : null)
        );
        if (d) {
          if (!title && d.title && d.title.runs && d.title.runs[0]) title = d.title.runs[0].text;
          if (!artist && d.shortBylineText && d.shortBylineText.runs) artist = d.shortBylineText.runs.map((r) => r.text).join('');
          if (!durationStr && d.lengthText && d.lengthText.runs && d.lengthText.runs[0]) durationStr = d.lengthText.runs[0].text;
          if (d.videoId) videoId = d.videoId;
        }

        if (!title) return;

        const isSelected =
          el.hasAttribute('selected') ||
          el.classList.contains('selected') ||
          el.getAttribute('play-button-state') === 'playing' ||
          el.getAttribute('play-button-state') === 'paused' ||
          Boolean(d && d.selected);

        if (wrapper && seenWrappers.has(wrapper)) {
          if (isSelected && extracted.length > 0) {
            const lastItem = extracted[extracted.length - 1];
            lastItem.selected = true;
            lastItem.domEl = el;
            activeIdx = extracted.length - 1;
          }
          return;
        }
        if (wrapper) seenWrappers.add(wrapper);

        const displayLabel = formatArtistAndTitle(artist, title);
        const normKey = normalizeTrackSignature(artist, title);

        const existingIdx = extracted.findIndex((item) =>
          item.normKey === normKey ||
          item.display.toLowerCase() === displayLabel.toLowerCase() ||
          (videoId && item.videoId === videoId)
        );
        if (existingIdx !== -1) {
          if (isSelected && !extracted[existingIdx].selected) {
            extracted[existingIdx].selected = true;
            extracted[existingIdx].domEl = el;
            activeIdx = existingIdx;
          }
          return;
        }

        const newIdx = extracted.length;
        if (isSelected && activeIdx === -1) activeIdx = newIdx;

        extracted.push({
          index: newIdx + 1,
          title,
          artist,
          display: displayLabel,
          normKey,
          durationStr: durationStr || '0:00',
          durationSec: parseDurationSec(durationStr),
          videoId,
          domEl: el,
          selected: isSelected
        });
      });
    }

    if (extracted.length === 0) {
      const pageItems = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('ytmusic-responsive-list-item-renderer, ytmusic-playlist-shelf-renderer ytmusic-responsive-list-item-renderer'));
      pageItems.forEach((el) => {
        const titleEl = el.querySelector('.title-column yt-formatted-string, .title');
        const secondaryEls = Array.from(el.querySelectorAll('.secondary-flex-columns yt-formatted-string'));
        const durEl = el.querySelector('.fixed-columns yt-formatted-string');
        const title = titleEl ? titleEl.textContent.trim() : '';
        const artist = secondaryEls.length > 0 ? secondaryEls[0].textContent.trim() : '';
        const durationStr = durEl ? durEl.textContent.trim() : '';
        if (title) {
          const displayLabel = formatArtistAndTitle(artist, title);
          const normKey = normalizeTrackSignature(artist, title);
          if (extracted.some((item) => item.normKey === normKey)) return;
          const newIdx = extracted.length;
          extracted.push({
            index: newIdx + 1,
            title,
            artist,
            display: displayLabel,
            normKey,
            durationStr: durationStr || '0:00',
            durationSec: parseDurationSec(durationStr),
            videoId: '',
            domEl: el,
            selected: newIdx === 0
          });
        }
      });
    }

    if (extracted.length === 0) {
      const barTitle = document.querySelector('ytmusic-player-bar yt-formatted-string.title')?.textContent?.trim() ||
                       document.querySelector('meta[property="og:title"]')?.getAttribute('content') ||
                       document.title.replace(/\s*\|\s*YouTube Music$/i, '').trim();
      const barArtist = document.querySelector('ytmusic-player-bar .byline-wrapper yt-formatted-string.byline')?.textContent?.trim() ||
                        document.querySelector('meta[property="og:description"]')?.getAttribute('content') || '';
      if (barTitle && barTitle !== 'YouTube Music') {
        const cleanArtist = barArtist.split('•')[0].trim();
        extracted.push({
          index: 1,
          title: barTitle,
          artist: cleanArtist,
          display: formatArtistAndTitle(cleanArtist, barTitle),
          normKey: normalizeTrackSignature(cleanArtist, barTitle),
          durationStr: STATE.duration > 0 ? formatTimeSec(STATE.duration) : '0:00',
          durationSec: STATE.duration || 0,
          videoId: '',
          domEl: null,
          selected: true
        });
        activeIdx = 0;
      }
    }

    const nowTitle = document.querySelector('ytmusic-player-bar yt-formatted-string.title')?.textContent?.trim();
    if (activeIdx === -1 && nowTitle) {
      activeIdx = extracted.findIndex((t) => t.title === nowTitle);
    }
    if (activeIdx === -1 && extracted.length > 0) activeIdx = 0;

    const sig = extracted.map((t) => `${t.index}:${t.display}:${t.durationStr}`).join('|') + `@${activeIdx}`;
    if (sig !== lastQueueSignature) {
      const prevIdx = STATE.currentIndex;
      lastQueueSignature = sig;
      STATE.tracks = extracted;
      STATE.currentIndex = activeIdx;
      if (STATE.selectedIndex === -1 || STATE.selectedIndex >= extracted.length || prevIdx !== activeIdx) {
        STATE.selectedIndex = activeIdx;
      }
      if (activeIdx >= 0 && prevIdx !== activeIdx) {
        const halfRows = Math.floor(STATE.visibleRows / 2);
        STATE.scrollOffset = Math.max(0, Math.min(Math.max(0, extracted.length - STATE.visibleRows), activeIdx - halfRows));
      }
      rebuildPlaylistDOM();
      renderPledit();
    }
  }

  function syncPlayerStateFromYTM() {
    const v = getVideoEl();
    if (v) {
      ensureAudioGraph(v);
      STATE.currentTime = v.currentTime || 0;
      if (isFinite(v.duration) && v.duration > 0) {
        STATE.duration = v.duration;
      }
      STATE.playing = !v.paused && !v.ended;
      STATE.paused = v.paused && v.currentTime > 0 && !STATE.stopped;
      if (STATE.playing) STATE.stopped = false;
      if (STATE.draggingAction !== 'vol') {
        STATE.volume = v.muted ? 0 : Math.round(v.volume * 255);
      }
    } else {
      const timeInfo = document.querySelector('ytmusic-player-bar .time-info')?.textContent?.trim();
      if (timeInfo && timeInfo.includes('/')) {
        const [curStr, totStr] = timeInfo.split('/').map((s) => s.trim());
        STATE.currentTime = parseDurationSec(curStr);
        STATE.duration = parseDurationSec(totStr);
        STATE.playing = true;
        STATE.stopped = false;
      }
    }

    if (STATE.currentIndex >= 0 && STATE.tracks[STATE.currentIndex] && STATE.duration > 0) {
      const curTrack = STATE.tracks[STATE.currentIndex];
      if (!curTrack.durationSec || Math.abs(curTrack.durationSec - STATE.duration) > 2) {
        curTrack.durationSec = Math.round(STATE.duration);
        curTrack.durationStr = formatTimeSec(STATE.duration);
      }
    }

    let currentSongLabel = '';
    if (STATE.currentIndex >= 0 && STATE.tracks[STATE.currentIndex]) {
      const tr = STATE.tracks[STATE.currentIndex];
      const durText = formatTimeSec(STATE.duration || tr.durationSec || 0);
      currentSongLabel = `${tr.index}. ${tr.display}`;
      STATE.marqueeText = `${tr.index}. ${tr.display} (${durText})  ***  `;
    } else {
      const barTitle = document.querySelector('ytmusic-player-bar yt-formatted-string.title')?.textContent?.trim();
      const barArtist = document.querySelector('ytmusic-player-bar .byline-wrapper yt-formatted-string.byline')?.textContent?.trim();
      if (barTitle) {
        const label = formatArtistAndTitle(barArtist, barTitle);
        currentSongLabel = `1. ${label}`;
        STATE.marqueeText = `1. ${label} (${formatTimeSec(STATE.duration)})  ***  `;
      }
    }

    // Şarkı değiştiğinde veya oynatma durumu (başladı / durdu) değiştiğinde AVS efektleri arasında başlığı göster!
    if (currentSongLabel && currentSongLabel !== STATE.lastSongBannerKey) {
      STATE.lastSongBannerKey = currentSongLabel;
      triggerAvsSongTransition(STATE.playing ? '♪ ŞİMDİ ÇALIYOR' : '♪ SEÇİLİ ŞARKI', currentSongLabel);
    } else if (STATE.lastPlayingState !== null && STATE.lastPlayingState !== STATE.playing && currentSongLabel) {
      triggerAvsSongTransition(STATE.playing ? '► OYNATILIYOR' : '❚❚ DURAKLATILDI', currentSongLabel);
    }
    STATE.lastPlayingState = STATE.playing;

    const shufBtn = document.querySelector('ytmusic-player-bar .shuffle, ytmusic-player-bar tp-yt-paper-icon-button.shuffle');
    if (shufBtn && shufBtn.getAttribute('aria-pressed')) {
      STATE.shuffle = shufBtn.getAttribute('aria-pressed') === 'true';
    }
    const repBtn = document.querySelector('ytmusic-player-bar .repeat, ytmusic-player-bar tp-yt-paper-icon-button.repeat');
    if (repBtn) {
      const titleAttr = (repBtn.getAttribute('title') || repBtn.getAttribute('aria-label') || '').toLowerCase();
      if (titleAttr.includes('kapalı') || titleAttr.includes('off')) STATE.repeat = false;
      else if (titleAttr) STATE.repeat = true;
    }
  }

  // =========================================================================
  // PLAYLIST EDITOR DOM SATIRLARI (TEK TIK SEÇER, ÇİFT TIK OYNATIR)
  // =========================================================================
  function rebuildPlaylistDOM() {
    while (pleditList.firstChild) pleditList.removeChild(pleditList.firstChild);

    const s = STATE.uiScale;
    const rowHeightPx = 13.55 * s;
    const fontSizePx = Math.max(9.5, Math.round(10.8 * s * 10) / 10);

    const maxScroll = Math.max(0, STATE.tracks.length - STATE.visibleRows);
    STATE.scrollOffset = Math.max(0, Math.min(maxScroll, STATE.scrollOffset));

    const slice = STATE.tracks.slice(STATE.scrollOffset, STATE.scrollOffset + STATE.visibleRows);
    slice.forEach((tr, i) => {
      const actualIdx = STATE.scrollOffset + i;
      const row = document.createElement('div');
      row.className = 'wa-pl-row';
      row.style.height = rowHeightPx + 'px';
      row.style.lineHeight = rowHeightPx + 'px';
      row.style.fontSize = fontSizePx + 'px';
      row.title = `${tr.index}. ${tr.display} (${tr.durationStr}) — Seçmek için tek tıklayın, oynatmak için çift tıklayın`;

      if (actualIdx === STATE.currentIndex) row.classList.add('wa-pl-current');
      if (actualIdx === STATE.selectedIndex || STATE.selectedIndices.has(actualIdx)) row.classList.add('wa-pl-selected');

      const leftSpan = document.createElement('span');
      leftSpan.className = 'wa-pl-title';
      leftSpan.textContent = `${tr.index}. ${tr.display}`;

      const rightSpan = document.createElement('span');
      rightSpan.className = 'wa-pl-dur';
      rightSpan.textContent = tr.durationStr || '0:00';

      row.appendChild(leftSpan);
      row.appendChild(rightSpan);

      row.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
        e.stopPropagation();
        if (e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) {
          if (STATE.selectedIndices.has(actualIdx)) STATE.selectedIndices.delete(actualIdx);
          else STATE.selectedIndices.add(actualIdx);
          STATE.selectedIndex = actualIdx;
        } else {
          STATE.selectedIndices.clear();
          STATE.selectedIndices.add(actualIdx);
          STATE.selectedIndex = actualIdx;
        }
        updatePlaylistDOMSelection();
      });

      row.addEventListener('dblclick', (e) => {
        e.stopPropagation();
        e.preventDefault();
        STATE.selectedIndices.clear();
        STATE.selectedIndices.add(actualIdx);
        STATE.selectedIndex = actualIdx;
        playQueueTrackAtIndex(actualIdx);
      });

      pleditList.appendChild(row);
    });
  }

  function updatePlaylistDOMSelection() {
    const rows = pleditList.querySelectorAll('.wa-pl-row');
    rows.forEach((row, i) => {
      const actualIdx = STATE.scrollOffset + i;
      row.classList.toggle('wa-pl-current', actualIdx === STATE.currentIndex);
      row.classList.toggle('wa-pl-selected', actualIdx === STATE.selectedIndex || STATE.selectedIndices.has(actualIdx));
    });
  }

  pleditList.addEventListener('wheel', (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const delta = e.deltaY > 0 ? 2 : -2;
    const maxScroll = Math.max(0, STATE.tracks.length - STATE.visibleRows);
    const nextScroll = Math.max(0, Math.min(maxScroll, STATE.scrollOffset + delta));
    if (nextScroll !== STATE.scrollOffset) {
      STATE.scrollOffset = nextScroll;
      rebuildPlaylistDOM();
      renderPledit();
    }
  }, { passive: false });

  // =========================================================================
  // SPEKTRUM ANALİZÖRÜ VE AVS GÖRSELLEŞTİRME HESAPLAMASI
  // =========================================================================
  const freqData = new Uint8Array(128);
  const timeData = new Uint8Array(128);

  function updateVisualizerData(now) {
    if (!STATE.playing) {
      for (let i = 0; i < 19; i++) {
        STATE.saBars[i] = Math.max(0, STATE.saBars[i] - 0.8);
        if (STATE.saPeakHold[i] > 0) STATE.saPeakHold[i]--;
        else STATE.saPeaks[i] = Math.max(0, STATE.saPeaks[i] - 0.45);
      }
      for (let x = 0; x < 76; x++) {
        STATE.oscData[x] *= 0.85;
      }
      return;
    }

    let gotRealAudio = false;
    if (analyserNode && !audioHookFailed) {
      analyserNode.getByteFrequencyData(freqData);
      let sum = 0;
      for (let i = 0; i < 32; i++) sum += freqData[i];
      if (sum > 0) {
        gotRealAudio = true;
        for (let b = 0; b < 19; b++) {
          const bin = Math.min(127, Math.floor(Math.pow(b / 19, 1.35) * 85) + 1);
          const val = (freqData[bin] / 255) * 15;
          if (val >= STATE.saBars[b]) STATE.saBars[b] = val;
          else STATE.saBars[b] = Math.max(0, STATE.saBars[b] - 0.75);

          if (STATE.saBars[b] >= STATE.saPeaks[b]) {
            STATE.saPeaks[b] = STATE.saBars[b];
            STATE.saPeakHold[b] = 12;
          } else if (STATE.saPeakHold[b] > 0) {
            STATE.saPeakHold[b]--;
          } else {
            STATE.saPeaks[b] = Math.max(0, STATE.saPeaks[b] - 0.35);
          }
        }
        analyserNode.getByteTimeDomainData(timeData);
        for (let x = 0; x < 76; x++) {
          STATE.oscData[x] = ((timeData[x] - 128) / 128) * 7;
        }
      }
    }

    if (!gotRealAudio) {
      const t = now * 0.008;
      const beat = Math.pow(0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(t * 2.1), 2);
      for (let b = 0; b < 19; b++) {
        const falloff = Math.max(0.12, Math.pow(1 - b / 19, 1.7));
        const wave = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(t * (1.3 + b * 0.37) + b * 0.9);
        const target = Math.min(14, (beat * 7 + wave * 6) * falloff * (STATE.volume / 220));
        if (target >= STATE.saBars[b]) STATE.saBars[b] = target;
        else STATE.saBars[b] = Math.max(0, STATE.saBars[b] - 0.7);

        if (STATE.saBars[b] >= STATE.saPeaks[b]) {
          STATE.saPeaks[b] = STATE.saBars[b];
          STATE.saPeakHold[b] = 14;
        } else if (STATE.saPeakHold[b] > 0) {
          STATE.saPeakHold[b]--;
        } else {
          STATE.saPeaks[b] = Math.max(0, STATE.saPeaks[b] - 0.3);
        }
      }
      for (let x = 0; x < 76; x++) {
        STATE.oscData[x] = Math.sin(t * 3 + x * 0.25) * 4.5 * Math.sin(t * 0.7 + x * 0.06);
      }
    }
  }

  const SA_COLORS = [
    '#D41810', '#D42810', '#D43C10', '#D45410',
    '#D46C10', '#D48810', '#D4A410', '#D4B818',
    '#B4C418', '#84C418', '#54C418', '#28C018',
    '#10B418', '#10A018', '#0C8C14', '#087410'
  ];

  // =========================================================================
  // 1) ANA PENCERE (MAIN WINDOW - 4X ULTRA HD + 6 MİNİ GÖRSELLEŞTİRİCİ MODU)
  // =========================================================================
  function renderMain() {
    if (!IMG.MAIN || !IMG.MAIN.complete) return;

    if (STATE.windowshade) {
      drawSprite(mainCtx, IMG.TITLEBAR, 27, STATE.activeWindow === 'main' ? 29 : 42, 275, 14, 0, 0, 275, 14);
      const dispSec = STATE.timeleftmode ? -Math.max(0, STATE.duration - STATE.currentTime) : STATE.currentTime;
      const absSec = Math.floor(Math.abs(dispSec));
      const mm = String(Math.floor(absSec / 60)).padStart(2, '0');
      const ss = String(absSec % 60).padStart(2, '0');
      drawTextBmp(mainCtx, (dispSec < 0 ? '-' : ' ') + mm + ':' + ss, 126, 4, 6);

      if (STATE.pressedBtn === 'tb_min') drawSprite(mainCtx, IMG.TITLEBAR, 9, 0, 9, 9, 244, 3, 9, 9);
      if (STATE.pressedBtn === 'tb_shade') drawSprite(mainCtx, IMG.TITLEBAR, 9, 27, 9, 9, 254, 3, 9, 9);
      if (STATE.pressedBtn === 'tb_close') drawSprite(mainCtx, IMG.TITLEBAR, 18, 0, 9, 9, 264, 3, 9, 9);
      return;
    }

    drawSprite(mainCtx, IMG.MAIN, 0, 0);
    drawSprite(mainCtx, IMG.TITLEBAR, 27, STATE.activeWindow === 'main' ? 0 : 15, 275, 14, 0, 0, 275, 14);
    drawHDTitlebarText(mainCtx, 'WINAMP', 135, 2.5, 46);

    if (STATE.pressedBtn === 'tb_min') drawSprite(mainCtx, IMG.TITLEBAR, 9, 0, 9, 9, 244, 3, 9, 9);
    if (STATE.pressedBtn === 'tb_shade') drawSprite(mainCtx, IMG.TITLEBAR, 0, 18, 9, 9, 254, 3, 9, 9);
    if (STATE.pressedBtn === 'tb_close') drawSprite(mainCtx, IMG.TITLEBAR, 18, 0, 9, 9, 264, 3, 9, 9);

    drawSprite(mainCtx, IMG.TITLEBAR, 304, 0, 8, 43, 10, 22, 8, 43);
    if (STATE.avsOpen) {
      mainCtx.fillStyle = '#00FF00';
      mainCtx.fillRect(11, 57, 6, 7);
      mainCtx.fillStyle = '#000000';
      mainCtx.font = 'bold 5.5px Arial';
      mainCtx.fillText('V', 12, 62.5);
    }

    drawSprite(mainCtx, IMG.PLAYPAUS, 36, 0, 3, 9, 24, 28, 3, 9);
    if (STATE.playing) {
      drawSprite(mainCtx, IMG.PLAYPAUS, 3, 0, 6, 9, 27, 28, 6, 9);
    } else if (STATE.paused) {
      drawSprite(mainCtx, IMG.PLAYPAUS, 9, 0, 9, 9, 26, 28, 9, 9);
    } else {
      drawSprite(mainCtx, IMG.PLAYPAUS, 18, 0, 9, 9, 26, 28, 9, 9);
    }

    const remainingSec = Math.max(0, (STATE.duration || 0) - STATE.currentTime);
    const displaySec = STATE.timeleftmode ? remainingSec : STATE.currentTime;
    const mins = Math.min(99, Math.floor(displaySec / 60));
    const secs = Math.floor(displaySec % 60);

    mainCtx.fillStyle = '#000000';
    mainCtx.fillRect(36, 25, 64, 15);
    if (STATE.timeleftmode) {
      mainCtx.fillStyle = '#00FF00';
      mainCtx.fillRect(39, 31.8, 5, 1.4);
    }
    mainCtx.fillStyle = '#00FF00';
    mainCtx.fillRect(71.5, 28.5, 1.6, 1.6);
    mainCtx.fillRect(71.5, 34.5, 1.6, 1.6);

    drawHDSevenSegmentDigit(mainCtx, Math.floor(mins / 10), 48, 26);
    drawHDSevenSegmentDigit(mainCtx, mins % 10, 60, 26);
    drawHDSevenSegmentDigit(mainCtx, Math.floor(secs / 10), 78, 26);
    drawHDSevenSegmentDigit(mainCtx, secs % 10, 90, 26);

    const now = performance.now();
    if (now < STATE.overrideUntil && STATE.overrideText) {
      drawTextBmp(mainCtx, STATE.overrideText.padEnd(31, ' '), 111, 27, 31, 0, 154);
    } else {
      const loopStr = STATE.marqueeText + STATE.marqueeText;
      const totalPx = Math.max(1, STATE.marqueeText.length * 5);
      const pxOff = STATE.marqueeOffset % totalPx;
      drawTextBmp(mainCtx, loopStr, 111, 27, loopStr.length, pxOff, 154);
    }

    drawTextBmp(mainCtx, String(STATE.kbps).padStart(3, ' '), 111, 43, 3);
    drawTextBmp(mainCtx, String(STATE.khz).padStart(2, ' '), 156, 43, 2);

    mainCtx.fillStyle = '#292939';
    mainCtx.fillRect(128, 41, 22, 10);
    mainCtx.fillRect(169, 41, 18, 10);
    mainCtx.font = 'bold 6.2px Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif';
    mainCtx.fillStyle = '#FFFFFF';
    mainCtx.fillText('kbps', 129, 48);
    mainCtx.fillText('kHz', 170, 48);

    drawSprite(mainCtx, IMG.MONOSTER, 29, 12, 29, 12, 212, 41, 29, 12);
    drawSprite(mainCtx, IMG.MONOSTER, 0, STATE.playing || STATE.paused ? 0 : 12, 29, 12, 239, 41, 29, 12);
    mainCtx.fillStyle = '#242434';
    mainCtx.fillRect(212, 42, 54, 10);
    mainCtx.font = 'bold 6.3px Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif';
    mainCtx.fillStyle = '#7A808E';
    mainCtx.fillText('mono', 214, 48.5);
    mainCtx.fillStyle = (STATE.playing || STATE.paused) ? '#00FF00' : '#3C5E44';
    mainCtx.fillText('stereo', 241, 48.5);

    // 9. Gelişmiş 6 Modlu Mini Görselleştirici (x=24..100, y=43..59 -> 76x16)
    if (STATE.saMode === 1) {
      // Mod 1: Klasik Winamp Spektrum Analizörü + Tepeler
      for (let b = 0; b < 19; b++) {
        const bx = 24 + b * 4;
        const h = Math.min(16, Math.round(STATE.saBars[b]));
        for (let py = 0; py < h; py++) {
          const rowIdx = 15 - py;
          mainCtx.fillStyle = SA_COLORS[rowIdx];
          mainCtx.fillRect(bx, 43 + rowIdx, 3, 0.85);
        }
        const pk = Math.min(15, Math.round(STATE.saPeaks[b]));
        if (pk > 0) {
          mainCtx.fillStyle = '#D8D8EC';
          mainCtx.fillRect(bx, 43 + (15 - pk), 3, 0.9);
        }
      }
    } else if (STATE.saMode === 2) {
      // Mod 2: Ateş (Fire) Spektrumu
      for (let b = 0; b < 19; b++) {
        const bx = 24 + b * 4;
        const h = Math.min(16, Math.round(STATE.saBars[b]));
        const grad = mainCtx.createLinearGradient(0, 43, 0, 59);
        grad.addColorStop(0, '#FFFFFF');
        grad.addColorStop(0.3, '#FFEE00');
        grad.addColorStop(0.7, '#FF4400');
        grad.addColorStop(1, '#660000');
        mainCtx.fillStyle = grad;
        mainCtx.fillRect(bx, 59 - h, 3.2, h);
      }
    } else if (STATE.saMode === 3) {
      // Mod 3: Çizgisel Tepe Spektrumu (Line Spectrum)
      mainCtx.strokeStyle = '#00FFCC';
      mainCtx.lineWidth = 1.2;
      mainCtx.beginPath();
      for (let b = 0; b < 19; b++) {
        const bx = 25.5 + b * 4;
        const by = 58 - Math.min(15, STATE.saBars[b]);
        if (b === 0) mainCtx.moveTo(bx, by);
        else mainCtx.lineTo(bx, by);
      }
      mainCtx.stroke();
    } else if (STATE.saMode === 4) {
      // Mod 4: Klasik Osiloskop Dalgası
      mainCtx.strokeStyle = '#00FF00';
      mainCtx.lineWidth = 1.1;
      mainCtx.beginPath();
      for (let x = 0; x < 76; x++) {
        const oy = Math.max(0, Math.min(15, 8 + STATE.oscData[x]));
        if (x === 0) mainCtx.moveTo(24 + x, 43 + oy);
        else mainCtx.lineTo(24 + x, 43 + oy);
      }
      mainCtx.stroke();
    } else if (STATE.saMode === 5) {
      // Mod 5: Nokta (Dot) Osiloskop
      for (let x = 0; x < 76; x++) {
        const oy = Math.max(0, Math.min(15, Math.round(8 + STATE.oscData[x])));
        mainCtx.fillStyle = Math.abs(STATE.oscData[x]) > 4 ? '#FF4422' : '#44FF44';
        mainCtx.fillRect(24 + x, 43 + oy, 1.3, 1.3);
      }
    } else if (STATE.saMode === 6) {
      // Mod 6: Yatay Stereo VU Metre
      const lVal = Math.min(72, Math.round(((STATE.saBars[0] + STATE.saBars[2] + STATE.saBars[4]) / 45) * 72));
      const rVal = Math.min(72, Math.round(((STATE.saBars[1] + STATE.saBars[3] + STATE.saBars[6]) / 45) * 72));
      const vuGrad = mainCtx.createLinearGradient(24, 0, 98, 0);
      vuGrad.addColorStop(0, '#00EE00');
      vuGrad.addColorStop(0.65, '#EEEE00');
      vuGrad.addColorStop(1, '#FF2200');
      mainCtx.fillStyle = vuGrad;
      mainCtx.fillRect(25, 45, lVal, 5);
      mainCtx.fillRect(25, 52, rVal, 5);
    }

    const volFrame = Math.min(27, Math.max(0, Math.floor((STATE.volume / 255) * 27)));
    drawSprite(mainCtx, IMG.VOLUME, 0, volFrame * 15, 68, 13, 107, 57, 68, 13);
    const volThumbX = 107 + Math.round((STATE.volume / 255) * 51);
    const volPressed = STATE.draggingAction === 'vol';
    drawSprite(mainCtx, IMG.VOLUME, volPressed ? 0 : 15, 422, 14, 11, volThumbX, 58, 14, 11);

    const balRatio = Math.abs(STATE.pan) / 127;
    const balFrame = Math.min(27, Math.max(0, Math.floor(balRatio * 27)));
    drawSprite(mainCtx, IMG.BALANCE, 9, balFrame * 15, 38, 13, 177, 57, 38, 13);
    const balThumbX = 177 + Math.round(((STATE.pan + 127) / 254) * 24);
    const balPressed = STATE.draggingAction === 'bal';
    drawSprite(mainCtx, IMG.BALANCE, balPressed ? 0 : 15, 422, 14, 11, balThumbX, 58, 14, 11);

    const eqPressed = STATE.pressedBtn === 'eq';
    drawSprite(mainCtx, IMG.SHUFREP, eqPressed ? 46 : 0, STATE.eqOpen ? 73 : 61, 23, 12, 219, 58, 23, 12);
    const plPressed = STATE.pressedBtn === 'pl';
    drawSprite(mainCtx, IMG.SHUFREP, plPressed ? 69 : 23, STATE.plOpen ? 73 : 61, 23, 12, 242, 58, 23, 12);

    drawSprite(mainCtx, IMG.POSBAR, 0, 0, 248, 10, 16, 72, 248, 10);
    const posRatio = STATE.draggingAction === 'pos'
      ? STATE.dragPosRatio
      : (STATE.duration > 0 ? Math.max(0, Math.min(1, STATE.currentTime / STATE.duration)) : 0);
    const posThumbX = 16 + Math.round(posRatio * 219);
    const posPressed = STATE.draggingAction === 'pos';
    drawSprite(mainCtx, IMG.POSBAR, posPressed ? 278 : 248, 0, 29, 10, posThumbX, 72, 29, 10);

    const btns = [
      { id: 'prev', sx: 0, w: 23, h: 18, dx: 16, dy: 88 },
      { id: 'play', sx: 23, w: 23, h: 18, dx: 39, dy: 88 },
      { id: 'pause', sx: 46, w: 23, h: 18, dx: 62, dy: 88 },
      { id: 'stop', sx: 69, w: 23, h: 18, dx: 85, dy: 88 },
      { id: 'next', sx: 92, w: 22, h: 18, dx: 108, dy: 88 },
      { id: 'eject', sx: 114, w: 22, h: 16, dx: 136, dy: 89 }
    ];
    btns.forEach((b) => {
      const isP = STATE.pressedBtn === b.id;
      drawSprite(mainCtx, IMG.CBUTTONS, b.sx, isP ? b.h : 0, b.w, b.h, b.dx, b.dy, b.w, b.h);
    });

    const shufP = STATE.pressedBtn === 'shuffle';
    drawSprite(mainCtx, IMG.SHUFREP, 28, (STATE.shuffle ? 30 : 0) + (shufP ? 15 : 0), 47, 15, 164, 89, 47, 15);
    const repP = STATE.pressedBtn === 'repeat';
    drawSprite(mainCtx, IMG.SHUFREP, 0, (STATE.repeat ? 30 : 0) + (repP ? 15 : 0), 28, 15, 210, 89, 28, 15);

    mainCtx.save();
    mainCtx.font = 'bold 5.8px Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif';
    mainCtx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    mainCtx.fillStyle = '#C5CAD6';
    mainCtx.fillRect(228, 60.5, 11, 7);
    mainCtx.fillStyle = '#182030';
    mainCtx.fillText('EQ', 228.5, 64.3);

    mainCtx.fillStyle = '#C5CAD6';
    mainCtx.fillRect(251, 60.5, 11, 7);
    mainCtx.fillStyle = '#182030';
    mainCtx.fillText('PL', 251.5, 64.3);

    mainCtx.fillStyle = '#C5CAD6';
    mainCtx.fillRect(173, 92.5, 34, 8);
    mainCtx.font = 'bold 5.8px Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif';
    mainCtx.fillStyle = '#182030';
    mainCtx.fillText('SHUFFLE', 174, 96.8);
    mainCtx.restore();
  }

  // =========================================================================
  // 2) EQUALIZER PENCERESİ RENDER FONKSİYONU
  // =========================================================================
  function renderEq() {
    if (STATE.windowshade || !STATE.eqOpen || !IMG.EQMAIN || !IMG.EQMAIN.complete) return;
    drawSprite(eqCtx, IMG.EQMAIN, 0, 0, 275, 116, 0, 0, 275, 116);
    drawSprite(eqCtx, IMG.EQMAIN, 0, STATE.activeWindow === 'eq' ? 134 : 149, 275, 14, 0, 0, 275, 14);
    drawHDTitlebarText(eqCtx, 'WINAMP EQUALIZER', 135, 2.5, 92);

    const onSy = 119;
    const onSx = (STATE.eqEnabled ? 69 : 10) + (STATE.pressedBtn === 'eq_on' ? 118 : 0);
    drawSprite(eqCtx, IMG.EQMAIN, onSx, onSy, 25, 12, 14, 18, 25, 12);

    const autoSx = (STATE.eqAuto ? 94 : 35) + (STATE.pressedBtn === 'eq_auto' ? 118 : 0);
    drawSprite(eqCtx, IMG.EQMAIN, autoSx, onSy, 33, 12, 39, 18, 33, 12);

    const allVals = [STATE.preamp, ...STATE.eqBands];
    const xCoords = [21, 78, 96, 114, 132, 150, 168, 186, 204, 222, 240];
    allVals.forEach((v, idx) => {
      const dx = xCoords[idx];
      const frame = Math.max(0, Math.min(27, Math.floor(((63 - v) / 63) * 27)));
      const col = frame % 14;
      const row = Math.floor(frame / 14);
      const sx = 13 + col * 15;
      const sy = 164 + row * 65;
      drawSprite(eqCtx, IMG.EQMAIN, sx, sy, 14, 63, dx, 38, 14, 63);
      const thumbY = 38 + Math.round((v / 63) * 50);
      const isP = STATE.draggingAction === (idx === 0 ? 'eq_preamp' : `eq_${idx - 1}`);
      drawSprite(eqCtx, IMG.EQMAIN, 0, isP ? 176 : 164, 11, 11, dx + 1, thumbY, 11, 11);
    });
  }

  // =========================================================================
  // 3) PLAYLIST EDITOR PENCERESİ RENDER FONKSİYONU
  // =========================================================================
  function renderPledit() {
    if (STATE.windowshade || !STATE.plOpen || !IMG.PLEDIT_BG || !IMG.PLEDIT_BG.complete) return;

    const W = STATE.plWidth;
    const H = STATE.plWindowshade ? 14 : STATE.plHeight;

    if (STATE.plWindowshade && IMG.PLEDIT && IMG.PLEDIT.complete) {
      drawSprite(pleditCtx, IMG.PLEDIT, 0, 42, 25, 14, 0, 0, 25, 14);
      for (let tx = 25; tx < W - 50; tx += 25) {
        drawSprite(pleditCtx, IMG.PLEDIT, 72, 42, 25, 14, tx, 0, 25, 14);
      }
      drawSprite(pleditCtx, IMG.PLEDIT, 26, STATE.activeWindow === 'pl' ? 42 : 57, 50, 14, W - 50, 0, 50, 14);
      const curTrack = STATE.tracks[STATE.currentIndex] || STATE.tracks[0];
      if (curTrack) {
        drawTextBmp(pleditCtx, `${curTrack.index}. ${curTrack.display}`, 8, 4, Math.floor((W - 65) / 5), 0, W - 65);
      }
      return;
    }

    const listAreaH = H - 58;

    drawSprite(pleditCtx, IMG.PLEDIT_BG, 0, 0, 25, 20, 0, 0, 25, 20);
    for (let tx = 25; tx < W - 25; tx += 25) {
      const tw = Math.min(25, (W - 25) - tx);
      drawSprite(pleditCtx, IMG.PLEDIT_BG, 25, 0, tw, 20, tx, 0, tw, 20);
    }
    const centerTitleX = Math.round((W - 100) / 2);
    drawSprite(pleditCtx, IMG.PLEDIT_BG, 87, 0, 100, 20, centerTitleX, 0, 100, 20);
    drawHDTitlebarText(pleditCtx, 'WINAMP PLAYLIST', W / 2, 2.5, 84);
    drawSprite(pleditCtx, IMG.PLEDIT_BG, 250, 0, 25, 20, W - 25, 0, 25, 20);

    pleditCtx.fillStyle = '#000000';
    pleditCtx.fillRect(12, 20, W - 32, listAreaH);
    for (let ty = 20; ty < H - 38; ty += 29) {
      const sliceH = Math.min(29, (H - 38) - ty);
      drawSprite(pleditCtx, IMG.PLEDIT_BG, 0, 20, 12, sliceH, 0, ty, 12, sliceH);
      drawSprite(pleditCtx, IMG.PLEDIT_BG, 255, 20, 20, sliceH, W - 20, ty, 20, sliceH);
    }

    drawSprite(pleditCtx, IMG.PLEDIT_BG, 0, 252, 125, 38, 0, H - 38, 125, 38);
    for (let tx = 125; tx < W - 150; tx += 4) {
      const tw = Math.min(4, (W - 150) - tx);
      drawSprite(pleditCtx, IMG.PLEDIT_BG, 121, 252, tw, 38, tx, H - 38, tw, 38);
    }
    drawSprite(pleditCtx, IMG.PLEDIT_BG, 125, 252, 150, 38, W - 150, H - 38, 150, 38);

    const plBtns = [
      { label: 'ADD', x: 25, y: H - 21 },
      { label: 'REM', x: 54, y: H - 21 },
      { label: 'SEL', x: 83, y: H - 21 },
      { label: 'MISC', x: 112, y: H - 21 }
    ];
    pleditCtx.save();
    pleditCtx.font = 'bold 5.8px Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif';
    pleditCtx.textAlign = 'center';
    pleditCtx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    plBtns.forEach((b) => {
      pleditCtx.fillStyle = '#CBD0DC';
      pleditCtx.fillRect(b.x - 9, b.y - 4.5, 18, 9);
      pleditCtx.fillStyle = '#182030';
      pleditCtx.fillText(b.label, b.x, b.y + 0.3);
    });
    const loX = W - 32;
    const loY = H - 21;
    pleditCtx.fillStyle = '#CBD0DC';
    pleditCtx.fillRect(loX - 9, loY - 6, 18, 12);
    pleditCtx.font = 'bold 5.0px Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif';
    pleditCtx.fillStyle = '#182030';
    pleditCtx.fillText('LIST', loX, loY - 2.3);
    pleditCtx.fillText('OPTS', loX, loY + 3.2);
    pleditCtx.restore();

    if (W >= 345) {
      const visBoxX = W - 222;
      const visBoxY = H - 30;
      pleditCtx.fillStyle = '#0A0B10';
      pleditCtx.fillRect(visBoxX, visBoxY, 72, 20);
      pleditCtx.strokeStyle = '#585A6E';
      pleditCtx.lineWidth = 1;
      pleditCtx.strokeRect(visBoxX + 0.5, visBoxY + 0.5, 71, 19);
      pleditCtx.fillStyle = '#1A242E';
      for (let py = 3; py < 18; py += 2) {
        for (let px = 3; px < 69; px += 2) {
          pleditCtx.fillRect(visBoxX + px, visBoxY + py, 0.8, 0.8);
        }
      }
      for (let b = 0; b < 16; b++) {
        const bx = visBoxX + 4 + b * 4;
        const bh = Math.min(14, Math.round((STATE.saBars[b] || 0) * 0.9));
        for (let py = 0; py < bh; py++) {
          const rowIdx = 15 - py;
