          pleditCtx.fillStyle = SA_COLORS[rowIdx];
          pleditCtx.fillRect(bx, visBoxY + 3 + (14 - py), 3, 0.85);
        }
      }
    }

    if (IMG.PLEDIT && IMG.PLEDIT.complete) {
      const maxScroll = Math.max(0, STATE.tracks.length - STATE.visibleRows);
      const scrollRatio = maxScroll > 0 ? Math.max(0, Math.min(1, STATE.scrollOffset / maxScroll)) : 0;
      const thumbY = 20 + Math.round(scrollRatio * Math.max(0, listAreaH - 18));
      const thumbPressed = STATE.draggingAction === 'plscroll';
      drawSprite(pleditCtx, IMG.PLEDIT, thumbPressed ? 61 : 52, 53, 8, 18, W - 15, thumbY, 8, 18);
    }

    const curTrack = STATE.tracks[STATE.currentIndex] || STATE.tracks[0];
    const curDurStr = curTrack ? (curTrack.durationStr || formatTimeSec(STATE.duration)) : '0:00';
    const totalSec = STATE.tracks.reduce((acc, t) => acc + (t.durationSec || 0), 0);
    const totalStr = `${curDurStr}/${formatTotalTime(totalSec)}+`;
    drawTextBmp(pleditCtx, totalStr, W - 143, H - 28, 17, 0, 88);

    const remSec = Math.max(0, (STATE.duration || 0) - STATE.currentTime);
    const dispSec = STATE.timeleftmode ? remSec : STATE.currentTime;
    const mins = Math.min(99, Math.floor(dispSec / 60));
    const secs = Math.floor(dispSec % 60);
    const miniClockStr = (STATE.timeleftmode ? '-' : ' ') +
      String(mins).padStart(2, '0') + ':' + String(secs).padStart(2, '0');
    drawTextBmp(pleditCtx, miniClockStr, W - 82, H - 15, 6, 0, 31);

    if (STATE.activePopup && IMG.PLEDIT && IMG.PLEDIT.complete) {
      const popups = {
        ADD:  { sx: 0,   sy: 111, w: 22, h: 54, dx: 14,      dy: H - 82 },
        REM:  { sx: 54,  sy: 111, w: 22, h: 72, dx: 43,      dy: H - 100 },
        SEL:  { sx: 104, sy: 111, w: 22, h: 54, dx: 72,      dy: H - 82 },
        MISC: { sx: 154, sy: 111, w: 22, h: 54, dx: 101,     dy: H - 82 },
        LIST: { sx: 204, sy: 111, w: 22, h: 54, dx: W - 43,  dy: H - 82 }
      };
      const p = popups[STATE.activePopup];
      if (p) {
        drawSprite(pleditCtx, IMG.PLEDIT, p.sx, p.sy, p.w, p.h, p.dx, p.dy, p.w, p.h);
      }
    }
  }

  // =========================================================================
  // 4) AVS VISUALIZATION PENCERESİ (12 KLASİK EFEKT + ŞARKI BAŞLIĞI ANİMASYONU)
  // =========================================================================
  const AVS_PRESET_NAMES = [
    '1. justin - quite nice.avs (Gökkuşağı Şeritler & Yıldırım)',
    '2. elvis_real3d_beatspiral.avs (3B Neon Ritim Sarmalı)',
    '3. justin - fireworks kaliadascope.avs (Kaleydoskop Havai Fişek)',
    '4. lone - superscope matrix.avs (3B Spektrum Matrisi)',
    '5. elvis_real3d_starfield.avs (3B Hiper-Uzay Yıldız Tüneli)',
    '6. Marco - Amanita Plasma.avs (Saykedelik Enerji Plazması)',
    '7. Zen-X - Aztec DNA Helix.avs (3B Çift Sarmal DNA Dalgaları)',
    '8. lone - Living Power Ball.avs (Bas Duyarlı Lazer Küresi)',
    '9. Tag - Retro Synthwave Grid.avs (3B Synthwave Ufuk Izgarası)',
    '10. Marco - Lissajous Phase.avs (Stereo Faz Osiloskobu)',
    '11. justin - Fire VuMeter.avs (Klasik Ateş Spektrumu)',
    '12. Zen-X - Matrix Rain & Scope.avs (Dijital Matrix Yağmuru)'
  ];

  // 3B Yıldız Tüneli parçacıkları (Preset 4 için)
  const stars = Array.from({ length: 90 }, () => ({
    x: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2,
    y: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2,
    z: Math.random()
  }));

  function openAvsPresetMenu() {
    while (avsList.firstChild) avsList.removeChild(avsList.firstChild);

    const autoItem = document.createElement('div');
    autoItem.className = 'wa-jump-item' + (STATE.avsAutoCycle ? ' wa-active' : '');
    autoItem.textContent = `🔄 Otomatik Efekt Döngüsü (Her 12 sn): ${STATE.avsAutoCycle ? 'AÇIK' : 'KAPALI'}`;
    autoItem.onclick = () => {
      STATE.avsAutoCycle = !STATE.avsAutoCycle;
      saveState();
      openAvsPresetMenu();
    };
    avsList.appendChild(autoItem);

    AVS_PRESET_NAMES.forEach((name, idx) => {
      const item = document.createElement('div');
      item.className = 'wa-jump-item' + (STATE.avsPreset === idx ? ' wa-active' : '');
      item.textContent = name;
      item.onclick = () => {
        STATE.avsPreset = idx;
        STATE.avsPresetLabelUntil = performance.now() + 2400;
        avsBufCtx.fillStyle = '#000000';
        avsBufCtx.fillRect(0, 0, avsBufferCanvas.width, avsBufferCanvas.height);
        avsMenu.style.display = 'none';
        saveState();
      };
      avsList.appendChild(item);
    });
    avsMenu.style.display = 'flex';
  }

  function renderAvs(now) {
    if (STATE.windowshade || !STATE.avsOpen) return;

    const curNow = now || performance.now();
    if (STATE.avsAutoCycle && STATE.playing && curNow - STATE.avsLastCycleTime > 12000) {
      STATE.avsPreset = (STATE.avsPreset + 1) % AVS_PRESET_NAMES.length;
      STATE.avsLastCycleTime = curNow;
      STATE.avsPresetLabelUntil = curNow + 2000;
    }

    const W = STATE.avsWidth;
    const H = STATE.avsWindowshade ? 14 : STATE.avsHeight;

    avsCtx.fillStyle = '#1F1F2E';
    avsCtx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    avsCtx.strokeStyle = '#5A5C70';
    avsCtx.lineWidth = 1;
    avsCtx.strokeRect(0.5, 0.5, W - 1, H - 1);
    avsCtx.strokeStyle = '#0D0D14';
    avsCtx.strokeRect(1.5, 1.5, W - 3, H - 3);

    avsCtx.fillStyle = STATE.activeWindow === 'avs' ? '#242436' : '#1B1B28';
    avsCtx.fillRect(2, 2, W - 4, 12);

    avsCtx.font = 'bold 7.2px Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif';
    avsCtx.fillStyle = '#000000';
    avsCtx.fillText('AVS', 6.5, 10.5);
    avsCtx.fillStyle = STATE.activeWindow === 'avs' ? '#FFFFFF' : '#9A9CAE';
    avsCtx.fillText('AVS', 6, 10);

    const barStartX = 26;
    const barEndX = W - 26;
    if (barEndX > barStartX) {
      const goldGrad = avsCtx.createLinearGradient(0, 4, 0, 11);
      if (STATE.activeWindow === 'avs') {
        goldGrad.addColorStop(0, '#E8CC7E');
        goldGrad.addColorStop(0.5, '#B69646');
        goldGrad.addColorStop(1, '#6E5824');
      } else {
        goldGrad.addColorStop(0, '#787888');
        goldGrad.addColorStop(1, '#444452');
      }
      avsCtx.fillStyle = goldGrad;
      avsCtx.fillRect(barStartX, 4.5, barEndX - barStartX, 2);
      avsCtx.fillRect(barStartX, 8, barEndX - barStartX, 2);
    }

    if (IMG.TITLEBAR && IMG.TITLEBAR.complete) {
      drawSprite(avsCtx, IMG.TITLEBAR, 0, 18, 9, 9, W - 22, 3, 9, 9);
      drawSprite(avsCtx, IMG.TITLEBAR, 18, 0, 9, 9, W - 12, 3, 9, 9);
    }

    if (STATE.avsWindowshade) return;

    const vx = 6;
    const vy = 15;
    const vw = W - 12;
    const vh = H - 21;

    avsCtx.strokeStyle = '#0A0A10';
    avsCtx.strokeRect(vx - 1, vy - 1, vw + 2, vh + 2);

    const bw = avsBufferCanvas.width;
    const bh = avsBufferCanvas.height;
    const t = curNow * 0.0018;
    const bass = ((STATE.saBars[0] || 0) + (STATE.saBars[1] || 0) + (STATE.saBars[2] || 0)) / 45;
    const mid = ((STATE.saBars[5] || 0) + (STATE.saBars[7] || 0) + (STATE.saBars[9] || 0)) / 45;
    const energy = STATE.playing ? Math.max(0.22, bass * 0.8 + mid * 0.5) : 0.08;

    avsBufCtx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.16)';
    avsBufCtx.fillRect(0, 0, bw, bh);

    const p = STATE.avsPreset % AVS_PRESET_NAMES.length;

    if (p === 0) {
      // 1. justin - quite nice.avs (Dikey Gökkuşağı Girişim Şeritleri & Beyaz Yıldırım)
      const ribbons = [
        { color: 'rgba(255, 25, 25, 0.42)',   offset: -0.26, freq: 2.1, phase: 0.4 },
        { color: 'rgba(255, 110, 20, 0.40)',  offset: -0.15, freq: 2.7, phase: 1.1 },
        { color: 'rgba(40, 255, 180, 0.44)',  offset: -0.04, freq: 3.3, phase: 2.0 },
        { color: 'rgba(40, 180, 255, 0.44)',  offset:  0.03, freq: 3.9, phase: 2.8 },
        { color: 'rgba(255, 255, 60, 0.48)',  offset:  0.12, freq: 2.4, phase: 3.5 },
        { color: 'rgba(80, 255, 40, 0.45)',   offset:  0.20, freq: 3.1, phase: 4.2 },
        { color: 'rgba(255, 40, 190, 0.38)',  offset:  0.08, freq: 4.5, phase: 5.0 }
      ];
      const centerX = bw * 0.44;
      ribbons.forEach((r, rIdx) => {
        avsBufCtx.strokeStyle = r.color;
        avsBufCtx.lineWidth = 1.4;
        for (let strand = 0; strand < 5; strand++) {
          avsBufCtx.beginPath();
          const sPhase = t * (1.4 + rIdx * 0.18) + strand * 0.32 + r.phase;
          for (let py = 0; py <= bh; py += 6) {
            const yn = py / bh;
            const osc = STATE.oscData[Math.floor(yn * 75)] || 0;
            const waveX =
              centerX +
              r.offset * bw +
              Math.sin(yn * Math.PI * r.freq + sPhase) * (24 + energy * 46) +
              Math.cos(yn * 12 - t * 2.5 + strand) * (10 + bass * 22) +
              osc * 2.4;
            if (py === 0) avsBufCtx.moveTo(waveX, py);
            else avsBufCtx.lineTo(waveX, py);
          }
          avsBufCtx.stroke();
        }
      });

      avsBufCtx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.92)';
      avsBufCtx.lineWidth = 2.0;
      avsBufCtx.beginPath();
      for (let py = 0; py <= bh; py += 4) {
        const yn = py / bh;
        const osc = STATE.oscData[Math.min(75, Math.floor(yn * 75))] || 0;
        const lx = centerX + bw * 0.05 + Math.sin(yn * 9 + t * 3.2) * (14 + bass * 30) + osc * (4.2 + energy * 5);
        if (py === 0) avsBufCtx.moveTo(lx, py);
        else avsBufCtx.lineTo(lx, py);
      }
      avsBufCtx.stroke();
    } else if (p === 1) {
      // 2. 3B Neon Ritim Sarmalı
      const cx = bw / 2, cy = bh / 2;
      for (let arm = 0; arm < 4; arm++) {
        avsBufCtx.strokeStyle = `hsla(${(t * 90 + arm * 90) % 360}, 100%, 60%, 0.78)`;
        avsBufCtx.lineWidth = 2.2;
        avsBufCtx.beginPath();
        for (let i = 0; i < 65; i++) {
          const r = (i / 65) * Math.min(cx, cy) * (0.85 + bass * 0.45);
          const ang = i * 0.22 + t * 2.4 + (arm * Math.PI) / 2;
          const ox = cx + Math.cos(ang) * r + (STATE.oscData[i] || 0) * 2.2;
          const oy = cy + Math.sin(ang) * r;
          if (i === 0) avsBufCtx.moveTo(ox, oy);
          else avsBufCtx.lineTo(ox, oy);
        }
        avsBufCtx.stroke();
      }
    } else if (p === 2) {
      // 3. Kaleydoskop Havai Fişek
      const cx = bw / 2, cy = bh / 2, slices = 8;
      for (let s = 0; s < slices; s++) {
        const baseAng = (s * Math.PI * 2) / slices + t * 0.8;
        avsBufCtx.strokeStyle = `hsla(${(t * 120 + s * 45) % 360}, 100%, 62%, 0.72)`;
        avsBufCtx.lineWidth = 1.9;
        avsBufCtx.beginPath();
        for (let b = 0; b < 19; b++) {
          const rad = 18 + b * 8 + (STATE.saBars[b] || 0) * 5.8;
          const a = baseAng + Math.sin(t * 2 + b * 0.3) * 0.35;
          const px = cx + Math.cos(a) * rad;
          const py = cy + Math.sin(a) * rad;
          if (b === 0) avsBufCtx.moveTo(px, py);
          else avsBufCtx.lineTo(px, py);
        }
        avsBufCtx.stroke();
      }
    } else if (p === 3) {
      // 4. 3B Spektrum Matrisi
      for (let b = 0; b < 19; b++) {
        const x = 20 + b * ((bw - 40) / 19);
        const h = ((STATE.saBars[b] || 0) / 16) * (bh * 0.78);
        const hue = 120 - (b / 19) * 120;
        avsBufCtx.fillStyle = `hsla(${hue}, 100%, 52%, 0.84)`;
        avsBufCtx.fillRect(x, bh - 20 - h, (bw - 40) / 22, h);
        const pk = ((STATE.saPeaks[b] || 0) / 16) * (bh * 0.78);
        avsBufCtx.fillStyle = '#FFFFFF';
        avsBufCtx.fillRect(x, bh - 24 - pk, (bw - 40) / 22, 3);
      }
    } else if (p === 4) {
      // 5. 3B Hiper-Uzay Yıldız Tüneli (Starfield Warp)
      const cx = bw / 2, cy = bh / 2;
      const speed = 0.012 + bass * 0.045;
      stars.forEach((st, i) => {
        st.z -= speed;
        if (st.z <= 0.04) {
          st.x = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2;
          st.y = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2;
          st.z = 1;
        }
        const sx = cx + (st.x / st.z) * (bw * 0.42);
        const sy = cy + (st.y / st.z) * (bh * 0.42);
        const sz = Math.max(1.5, (1 - st.z) * 5.5);
        avsBufCtx.fillStyle = `hsla(${(i * 15 + t * 120) % 360}, 90%, 75%, ${1 - st.z * 0.7})`;
        avsBufCtx.beginPath();
        avsBufCtx.arc(sx, sy, sz, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        avsBufCtx.fill();
      });
    } else if (p === 5) {
      // 6. Saykedelik Enerji Plazması
      const cx = bw / 2, cy = bh / 2;
      for (let ring = 0; ring < 7; ring++) {
        avsBufCtx.strokeStyle = `hsla(${(t * 70 + ring * 50) % 360}, 100%, 58%, 0.65)`;
        avsBufCtx.lineWidth = 2.4;
        avsBufCtx.beginPath();
        for (let a = 0; a <= Math.PI * 2 + 0.1; a += 0.12) {
          const wave = Math.sin(a * (3 + ring) + t * 3) * (15 + bass * 38);
          const rad = 25 + ring * 20 + wave;
          const px = cx + Math.cos(a) * rad;
          const py = cy + Math.sin(a) * rad;
          if (a === 0) avsBufCtx.moveTo(px, py);
          else avsBufCtx.lineTo(px, py);
        }
        avsBufCtx.stroke();
      }
    } else if (p === 6) {
      // 7. 3B Çift Sarmal DNA Dalgaları
      const cy = bh / 2;
      for (let x = 20; x < bw - 20; x += 10) {
        const xn = x / bw;
        const y1 = cy + Math.sin(xn * 8 + t * 3.2) * (50 + bass * 65);
        const y2 = cy + Math.sin(xn * 8 + t * 3.2 + Math.PI) * (50 + bass * 65);
        avsBufCtx.strokeStyle = `hsla(${(xn * 300 + t * 80) % 360}, 100%, 60%, 0.55)`;
        avsBufCtx.lineWidth = 1.6;
        avsBufCtx.beginPath();
        avsBufCtx.moveTo(x, y1);
        avsBufCtx.lineTo(x, y2);
        avsBufCtx.stroke();

        avsBufCtx.fillStyle = '#00FFCC';
        avsBufCtx.fillRect(x - 2.5, y1 - 2.5, 5, 5);
        avsBufCtx.fillStyle = '#FF44CC';
        avsBufCtx.fillRect(x - 2.5, y2 - 2.5, 5, 5);
      }
    } else if (p === 7) {
      // 8. Bas Duyarlı Elektrikli Lazer Küresi
      const cx = bw / 2, cy = bh / 2;
      const baseR = 45 + bass * 75;
      for (let ray = 0; ray < 24; ray++) {
        const ang = (ray / 24) * Math.PI * 2 + t * 1.1;
        const rLen = baseR + (STATE.saBars[ray % 19] || 0) * 6.5;
        avsBufCtx.strokeStyle = `hsla(${(ray * 15 + t * 140) % 360}, 100%, 65%, 0.8)`;
        avsBufCtx.lineWidth = 2;
        avsBufCtx.beginPath();
        avsBufCtx.moveTo(cx, cy);
        avsBufCtx.lineTo(cx + Math.cos(ang) * rLen, cy + Math.sin(ang) * rLen);
        avsBufCtx.stroke();
      }
    } else if (p === 8) {
      // 9. 3B Retro Synthwave Ufuk Izgarası & Güneş
      const horizonY = bh * 0.48;
      const sunGrad = avsBufCtx.createLinearGradient(0, horizonY - 85, 0, horizonY);
      sunGrad.addColorStop(0, '#FFCC00');
      sunGrad.addColorStop(1, '#FF0066');
      avsBufCtx.fillStyle = sunGrad;
      avsBufCtx.beginPath();
      avsBufCtx.arc(bw / 2, horizonY - 10, 52 + bass * 18, Math.PI, 0);
      avsBufCtx.fill();

      avsBufCtx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0, 255, 255, 0.65)';
      avsBufCtx.lineWidth = 1.4;
      for (let i = -8; i <= 8; i++) {
        avsBufCtx.beginPath();
        avsBufCtx.moveTo(bw / 2 + i * 12, horizonY);
        avsBufCtx.lineTo(bw / 2 + i * 65, bh);
        avsBufCtx.stroke();
      }
      for (let z = 1; z <= 8; z++) {
        const gy = horizonY + ((z + (t * 3) % 1) / 9) * (bh - horizonY);
        avsBufCtx.beginPath();
        avsBufCtx.moveTo(0, gy);
        avsBufCtx.lineTo(bw, gy);
        avsBufCtx.stroke();
      }
    } else if (p === 9) {
      // 10. Lissajous Stereo Faz Osiloskobu
      const cx = bw / 2, cy = bh / 2;
      avsBufCtx.strokeStyle = '#00FF88';
      avsBufCtx.lineWidth = 2.0;
      avsBufCtx.beginPath();
      for (let i = 0; i < 75; i++) {
        const ox = cx + Math.sin(i * 0.18 + t * 2.7) * (80 + bass * 60) + (STATE.oscData[i] || 0) * 5;
        const oy = cy + Math.cos(i * 0.24 - t * 1.9) * (65 + mid * 55) + (STATE.oscData[75 - i] || 0) * 5;
        if (i === 0) avsBufCtx.moveTo(ox, oy);
        else avsBufCtx.lineTo(ox, oy);
      }
      avsBufCtx.stroke();
    } else if (p === 10) {
      // 11. Klasik Ateş Spektrumu (Fire VuMeter)
      for (let b = 0; b < 19; b++) {
        const x = 16 + b * ((bw - 32) / 19);
        const h = ((STATE.saBars[b] || 0) / 16) * (bh * 0.82);
        const fGrad = avsBufCtx.createLinearGradient(0, bh - h, 0, bh);
        fGrad.addColorStop(0, '#FFFFFF');
        fGrad.addColorStop(0.25, '#FFFF00');
        fGrad.addColorStop(0.6, '#FF5500');
        fGrad.addColorStop(1, '#550000');
        avsBufCtx.fillStyle = fGrad;
        avsBufCtx.fillRect(x, bh - 12 - h, (bw - 32) / 21, h);
      }
    } else {
      // 12. Dijital Matrix Yağmuru & Dalga
      avsBufCtx.fillStyle = '#00FF44';
      avsBufCtx.font = 'bold 14px monospace';
      for (let col = 0; col < 26; col++) {
        const mx = col * 20 + 6;
        const my = ((curNow * (0.12 + (col % 5) * 0.03) + col * 83) % bh);
        const ch = String.fromCharCode(0x30A0 + ((col * 7 + Math.floor(t * 10)) % 64));
        avsBufCtx.fillText(ch, mx, my);
      }
      avsBufCtx.strokeStyle = '#FFFFFF';
      avsBufCtx.lineWidth = 2;
      avsBufCtx.beginPath();
      for (let x = 0; x < 76; x++) {
        const px = (x / 75) * bw;
        const py = bh / 2 + (STATE.oscData[x] || 0) * 9;
        if (x === 0) avsBufCtx.moveTo(px, py);
        else avsBufCtx.lineTo(px, py);
      }
      avsBufCtx.stroke();
    }

    // ŞARKI BAŞLADIĞINDA / DURDUĞUNDA / DEĞİŞTİĞİNDE EFEKTLER ARASINDA GÖRÜNÜP KAYBOLAN BAŞLIK ANİMASYONU!
    const anim = STATE.avsTitleAnim;
    if (anim && anim.text && curNow - anim.startTime < anim.duration) {
      const elapsed = curNow - anim.startTime;
      const progress = elapsed / anim.duration;
      // İlk %18'de belirir (fade-in), ortada parlar, son %32'de yavaşça efektlerin içinde kaybolur (fade-out)
      let alpha = 1;
      if (progress < 0.18) alpha = progress / 0.18;
      else if (progress > 0.68) alpha = Math.max(0, (1 - progress) / 0.32);

      const scaleWave = 1 + Math.sin(progress * Math.PI) * 0.06 + bass * 0.08;
      const driftY = Math.sin(elapsed * 0.004) * 8;

      avsBufCtx.save();
      avsBufCtx.translate(bw / 2, bh / 2 + driftY);
      avsBufCtx.scale(scaleWave, scaleWave);
      avsBufCtx.textAlign = 'center';
      avsBufCtx.textBaseline = 'middle';

      // Neon hale (glow) efektiyle görselleştirme dalgalarının içinde kaynaşır
      avsBufCtx.shadowColor = `hsla(${(t * 110) % 360}, 100%, 60%, ${alpha * 0.95})`;
      avsBufCtx.shadowBlur = 18;

      // Alt durum etiketi (► OYNATILIYOR / ❚❚ DURAKLATILDI / ♪ ŞİMDİ ÇALIYOR)
      avsBufCtx.font = 'bold 13px Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif';
      avsBufCtx.fillStyle = `rgba(0, 255, 160, ${alpha * 0.92})`;
      avsBufCtx.fillText(anim.subText, 0, -18);

      // Şarkı başlığı (uzunsa iki satıra böl veya sığdır)
      avsBufCtx.font = 'bold 20px Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif';
      avsBufCtx.strokeStyle = `rgba(0, 0, 0, ${alpha * 0.85})`;
      avsBufCtx.lineWidth = 4;
      const maxLineLen = 34;
      if (anim.text.length > maxLineLen && anim.text.includes(' - ')) {
        const parts = anim.text.split(' - ');
        const line1 = parts[0];
        const line2 = parts.slice(1).join(' - ');
        avsBufCtx.strokeText(line1, 0, 4);
        avsBufCtx.strokeText(line2, 0, 28);
        avsBufCtx.fillStyle = `rgba(255, 255, 255, ${alpha})`;
        avsBufCtx.fillText(line1, 0, 4);
        avsBufCtx.fillStyle = `rgba(255, 240, 130, ${alpha})`;
        avsBufCtx.fillText(line2, 0, 28);
      } else {
        avsBufCtx.strokeText(anim.text, 0, 10);
        avsBufCtx.fillStyle = `rgba(255, 255, 255, ${alpha})`;
        avsBufCtx.fillText(anim.text, 0, 10);
      }
      avsBufCtx.restore();
    }

    avsCtx.drawImage(avsBufferCanvas, 0, 0, bw, bh, vx, vy, vw, vh);

    if (curNow < STATE.avsPresetLabelUntil) {
      avsCtx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.76)';
      avsCtx.fillRect(vx + 4, vy + 4, vw - 8, 14);
      drawTextBmp(avsCtx, AVS_PRESET_NAMES[p], vx + 8, vy + 8, Math.floor((vw - 16) / 5), 0, vw - 16);
    }
  }

  function renderAll(now) {
    renderMain();
    renderEq();
    renderPledit();
    renderAvs(now);
  }

  // =========================================================================
  // TÜM BUTON VE KONTROLLER İÇİN FARE ÜSTÜNDE BEKLEME AÇIKLAMALARI (TOOLTIPS)
  // =========================================================================
  function getMainTooltipAt(x, y) {
    if (inBox(x, y, 2, 2, 13, 11)) {
      return (STATE.popoutWin && !STATE.popoutWin.closed)
        ? 'Ana YouTube Music Sekmesine Geri Gönder'
        : 'Winamp Penceresini Chrome Dışına Taşı (Masaüstü Uygulama Modu)';
    }
    if (inBox(x, y, 244, 2, 10, 10)) return 'Simge Durumuna Küçült / Aynı Yerden Geri Aç';
    if (inBox(x, y, 254, 2, 10, 10)) return 'Başlık Çubuğu Moduna Küçült / Geri Aç (Windowshade)';
    if (inBox(x, y, 264, 2, 10, 10)) return 'Winamp Penceresini Başlık Çubuğuna Küçült / Geri Aç';

    if (STATE.windowshade) {
      if (inBox(x, y, 168, 2, 8, 10)) return 'Önceki Şarkı (Previous)';
      if (inBox(x, y, 176, 2, 10, 10)) return 'Oynat (Play)';
      if (inBox(x, y, 186, 2, 9, 10)) return 'Duraklat (Pause)';
      if (inBox(x, y, 195, 2, 9, 10)) return 'Durdur (Stop)';
      if (inBox(x, y, 204, 2, 11, 10)) return 'Sonraki Şarkı (Next)';
      if (inBox(x, y, 215, 2, 10, 10)) return 'Şarkı Ara / Listede Atla (Jump to File)';
      if (inBox(x, y, 125, 2, 38, 10)) return 'Zaman Sayacı (Geçen / Kalan Süre değiştirmek için tıklayın)';
      return 'Winamp Başlık Çubuğu (Taşımak için sürükleyin, açmak için çift tıklayın)';
    }

    if (y < 14) return 'Winamp Başlık Çubuğu (Taşımak için sürükleyin, küçültmek için çift tıklayın)';
    if (inBox(x, y, 10, 22, 8, 8)) return 'O: Görselleştirici Modunu Değiştir';
    if (inBox(x, y, 10, 30, 8, 7)) return 'A: Chrome Dışına Taşı / Masaüstü Modu';
    if (inBox(x, y, 10, 37, 8, 7)) return 'I: Şarkı Başlığını AVS İçinde Göster';
    if (inBox(x, y, 10, 44, 8, 9)) return 'D: Pencere Ölçeğini Büyüt / Küçült (Double Size)';
    if (inBox(x, y, 10, 55, 8, 10)) return 'V: AVS Görselleştirme (Visualization) Penceresini Aç/Kapat (Alt+V)';
    if (inBox(x, y, 36, 26, 65, 13)) return 'Zaman Sayacı (Geçen Süre / Kalan Süre değiştirmek için tıklayın)';
    if (inBox(x, y, 24, 43, 76, 16)) return 'Mini Görselleştirici (6 farklı Spektrum / Osiloskop / VU Metre modu için tıklayın)';
    if (inBox(x, y, 111, 24, 154, 12)) return 'Şu An Çalan Şarkı Adı ve Süresi';
    if (inBox(x, y, 110, 41, 38, 10)) return 'Ses Bit Hızı (128 kbps)';
    if (inBox(x, y, 155, 41, 32, 10)) return 'Örnekleme Frekansı (44 kHz)';
    if (inBox(x, y, 212, 41, 56, 12)) return 'Stereo / Mono Ses Çıkış Göstergesi';
    if (inBox(x, y, 107, 56, 68, 14)) return `Ses Düzeyi Sürgüsü (Volume: %${Math.round((STATE.volume / 255) * 100)})`;
    if (inBox(x, y, 177, 56, 38, 14)) return 'Sağ / Sol Hoparlör Denge Sürgüsü (Balance)';
    if (inBox(x, y, 219, 58, 23, 12)) return 'Grafik Ekolayzer (EQ) Penceresini Aç/Kapat (Alt+G)';
    if (inBox(x, y, 242, 58, 23, 12)) return 'Çalma Listesi (PL) Penceresini Aç/Kapat (Alt+E)';
    if (inBox(x, y, 16, 70, 248, 14)) return 'Şarkı İlerleme ve İleri/Geri Sarma Çubuğu (Seek Bar)';
    if (inBox(x, y, 16, 88, 23, 18)) return 'Önceki Şarkı (Previous)';
    if (inBox(x, y, 39, 88, 23, 18)) return 'Oynat / Baştan Başlat (Play)';
    if (inBox(x, y, 62, 88, 23, 18)) return 'Duraklat / Devam Et (Pause)';
    if (inBox(x, y, 85, 88, 23, 18)) return 'Durdur (Stop)';
    if (inBox(x, y, 108, 88, 22, 18)) return 'Sonraki Şarkı (Next)';
    if (inBox(x, y, 136, 89, 22, 16)) return 'Şarkı Ara / Listede Hızlı Atla (Jump to File - F3)';
    if (inBox(x, y, 164, 89, 47, 15)) return `Karışık Çalma (Shuffle: ${STATE.shuffle ? 'Açık' : 'Kapalı'})`;
    if (inBox(x, y, 210, 89, 28, 15)) return `Tekrar Çalma (Repeat: ${STATE.repeat ? 'Açık' : 'Kapalı'})`;
    if (inBox(x, y, 250, 89, 20, 20)) return 'AVS Görselleştirme Penceresini Aç/Kapat ve Kuyruğu Senkronize Et';
    return '';
  }

  function getPlTooltipAt(x, y) {
    const W = STATE.plWidth;
    const H = STATE.plWindowshade ? 14 : STATE.plHeight;
    if (inBox(x, y, W - 21, 2, 10, 10)) return 'Çalma Listesini Başlık Çubuğuna Küçült / Aç';
    if (inBox(x, y, W - 11, 2, 10, 10)) return 'Çalma Listesi Penceresini Kapat (Alt+E)';
    if (y < 14) return 'Çalma Listesi Başlığı (Ayırmak/Birleştirmek için sürükleyin, küçültmek için çift tıklayın)';
    if (STATE.plWindowshade) return '';
    if (inBox(x, y, W - 21, H - 20, 21, 20)) return 'Çalma Listesi Penceresini Köşeden Büyüt / Küçült';
    if (inBox(x, y, W - 19, 20, 16, H - 58)) return 'Çalma Listesi Kaydırma Çubuğu (Scrollbar)';
    if (inBox(x, y, W - 19, H - 38, 16, 16)) return 'Listeyi Yukarı / Aşağı Kaydır';
    if (inBox(x, y, 14, H - 30, 22, 20)) return 'ADD: Listede Şarkı Ara';
    if (inBox(x, y, 43, H - 30, 22, 20)) return 'REM: Seçili Şarkıyı veya Listeyi Kaldır';
    if (inBox(x, y, 72, H - 30, 22, 20)) return 'SEL: Tümünü Seç / Seçimi Kaldır / Tersine Çevir';
    if (inBox(x, y, 101, H - 30, 22, 20)) return 'MISC: Listeyi Alfabetik Sırala / Şarkı Ara';
    if (inBox(x, y, W - 43, H - 30, 22, 20)) return 'LIST OPTS: YouTube Music Çalma Sırasını Yenile';
    if (inBox(x, y, W - 145, H - 18, 54, 12)) return 'Mini Oynatma Kontrolleri (Önceki, Oynat, Duraklat, Durdur, Sonraki, Ara)';
    if (inBox(x, y, W - 143, H - 30, 88, 10)) return 'Çalan Şarkı Süresi / Toplam Liste Süresi';
    if (inBox(x, y, W - 87, H - 18, 35, 12)) return 'Mini Zaman Sayacı (Geçen / Kalan Süre)';
    return '';
  }

  function getAvsTooltipAt(x, y) {
    const W = STATE.avsWidth;
    const H = STATE.avsWindowshade ? 14 : STATE.avsHeight;
    if (inBox(x, y, 2, 2, 24, 11)) return 'AVS Efekt Seçici Menüsünü Aç (12 Farklı Efekt)';
    if (inBox(x, y, W - 23, 2, 10, 10)) return 'AVS Penceresini Başlık Çubuğuna Küçült / Aç';
    if (inBox(x, y, W - 13, 2, 11, 11)) return 'AVS Görselleştirme Penceresini Kapat (Alt+V)';
    if (y < 14) return 'AVS Başlık Çubuğu (Ayırmak/Birleştirmek için sürükleyin, küçültmek için çift tıklayın)';
    if (STATE.avsWindowshade) return '';
    if (inBox(x, y, W - 18, H - 18, 18, 18)) return 'AVS Penceresini Köşeden Büyüt / Küçült';
    return `AVS Görselleştirme Sahnesi (${AVS_PRESET_NAMES[STATE.avsPreset]} — Sol tık: Sonraki efekt, Sağ tık: Efekt menüsü)`;
  }

  function getEqTooltipAt(x, y) {
    if (inBox(x, y, 264, 3, 9, 9)) return 'Ekolayzer Penceresini Kapat (Alt+G)';
    if (y < 14) return 'Ekolayzer Başlık Çubuğu (Ayırmak/Birleştirmek için sürükleyin)';
    if (inBox(x, y, 14, 18, 25, 12)) return `Ekolayzeri Etkinleştir / Kapat (Şu an: ${STATE.eqEnabled ? 'Açık' : 'Kapalı'})`;
    if (inBox(x, y, 39, 18, 33, 12)) return 'Otomatik Ekolayzer (Auto EQ)';
    if (inBox(x, y, 21, 38, 14, 63)) return 'Ön Yükseltici (Preamp) Sürgüsü';
    if (inBox(x, y, 78, 38, 180, 63)) return '10 Bant Frekans Ekolayzer Sürgüleri (60Hz - 16kHz)';
    return '';
  }

  mainCanvas.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
    const { x, y } = getCanvasCoords(mainCanvas, e.clientX, e.clientY);
    showWinampTooltip(getMainTooltipAt(x, y), e.clientX, e.clientY, mainCanvas);
  });
  mainCanvas.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => showWinampTooltip('', 0, 0, mainCanvas));

  pleditCanvas.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
    const { x, y } = getCanvasCoords(pleditCanvas, e.clientX, e.clientY);
    showWinampTooltip(getPlTooltipAt(x, y), e.clientX, e.clientY, pleditCanvas);
  });
  pleditCanvas.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => showWinampTooltip('', 0, 0, pleditCanvas));

  avsCanvas.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
    const { x, y } = getCanvasCoords(avsCanvas, e.clientX, e.clientY);
    showWinampTooltip(getAvsTooltipAt(x, y), e.clientX, e.clientY, avsCanvas);
  });
  avsCanvas.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => showWinampTooltip('', 0, 0, avsCanvas));

  eqCanvas.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
    const { x, y } = getCanvasCoords(eqCanvas, e.clientX, e.clientY);
    showWinampTooltip(getEqTooltipAt(x, y), e.clientX, e.clientY, eqCanvas);
  });
  eqCanvas.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => showWinampTooltip('', 0, 0, eqCanvas));

  // =========================================================================
  // FARE VE PENCERE ETKİLEŞİMLERİ
  // =========================================================================
  function setActiveWin(name) {
    STATE.activeWindow = name;
    winMain.classList.toggle('wa-win-active', name === 'main');
    winPl.classList.toggle('wa-win-active', name === 'pl');
    winAvs.classList.toggle('wa-win-active', name === 'avs');
    winEq.classList.toggle('wa-win-active', name === 'eq');
  }

  function getCanvasCoords(canvas, clientX, clientY) {
    const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    return {
      x: (clientX - rect.left) / STATE.uiScale,
      y: (clientY - rect.top) / STATE.uiScale
    };
  }

  function inBox(x, y, bx, by, bw, bh) {
    return x >= bx && x < bx + bw && y >= by && y < by + bh;
  }

  let dragStartX = 0;
  let dragStartY = 0;
  let dragInit = {};

  function startDragAction(action, e, extra = {}) {
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();
    showWinampTooltip('', 0, 0);
    STATE.draggingAction = action;
    dragStartX = e.screenX;
    dragStartY = e.screenY;
    dragInit = {
      wx: STATE.wx,
      wy: STATE.wy,
      plX: STATE.plX,
      plY: STATE.plY,
      plW: STATE.plWidth,
      plH: STATE.plHeight,
      avsX: STATE.avsX,
      avsY: STATE.avsY,
      avsW: STATE.avsWidth,
      avsH: STATE.avsHeight,
      eqX: STATE.eqX,
      eqY: STATE.eqY,
      uiScale: STATE.uiScale,
      ...extra
    };
  }

  mainResizeSE.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => {
    if (e.button !== 0) return;
    startDragAction('resize_scale', e);
  });

  workspaceRoot.querySelectorAll('.wa-resize-handle[data-resize-target]').forEach((h) => {
    h.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => {
      if (e.button !== 0) return;
      startDragAction('resize_' + h.dataset.resizeTarget, e, { dir: h.dataset.resizeDir || 'se' });
    });
  });

  function toggleMainInPlaceCollapse() {
    STATE.windowshade = !STATE.windowshade;
    syncDockedPositions();
    applyGeometryAndScale();
    saveState();
    renderAll();
  }

  // 1) Ana Pencere Tıklamaları
  mainCanvas.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => {
    if (e.button !== 0) return;
    setActiveWin('main');
    const { x, y } = getCanvasCoords(mainCanvas, e.clientX, e.clientY);

    // Sol üst Winamp ikonu (x=2..15, y=2..12) -> Chrome Dışına Taşı / Geri Getir!
    if (inBox(x, y, 2, 2, 13, 11)) {
      toggleExternalDesktopWindow();
      return;
    }

    if (inBox(x, y, 244, 2, 10, 10)) { STATE.pressedBtn = 'tb_min'; renderMain(); return; }
    if (inBox(x, y, 254, 2, 10, 10)) { STATE.pressedBtn = 'tb_shade'; renderMain(); return; }
    if (inBox(x, y, 264, 2, 10, 10)) { STATE.pressedBtn = 'tb_close'; renderMain(); return; }

    if (STATE.windowshade) {
      if (inBox(x, y, 168, 2, 8, 10)) { ytmPrev(); return; }
      if (inBox(x, y, 176, 2, 10, 10)) { ytmPlay(); return; }
      if (inBox(x, y, 186, 2, 9, 10)) { ytmPause(); return; }
      if (inBox(x, y, 195, 2, 9, 10)) { ytmStop(); return; }
      if (inBox(x, y, 204, 2, 11, 10)) { ytmNext(); return; }
      if (inBox(x, y, 215, 2, 10, 10)) { toggleMainInPlaceCollapse(); openJumpModal(); return; }
      if (inBox(x, y, 125, 2, 38, 10)) {
        STATE.timeleftmode = STATE.timeleftmode ? 0 : 1;
        saveState();
        renderMain();
        return;
      }
      startDragAction('move_main', e);
      return;
    }

    if (y < 14) {
      startDragAction('move_main', e);
      return;
    }

    // Clutterbar O, A, I, D, V butonları
    if (inBox(x, y, 10, 22, 8, 8)) {
      STATE.saMode = (STATE.saMode + 1) % 7;
      setStatusOverride(`MINI VIS MODE: ${STATE.saMode}`);
      saveState();
      renderMain();
      return;
    }
    if (inBox(x, y, 10, 30, 8, 7)) {
      toggleExternalDesktopWindow();
      return;
    }
    if (inBox(x, y, 10, 37, 8, 7)) {
      triggerAvsSongTransition('♪ ŞARKI BİLGİSİ', getCurrentSongLabel());
      return;
    }
    if (inBox(x, y, 10, 44, 8, 9)) {
      STATE.uiScale = STATE.uiScale > 1.55 ? 1.25 : 1.7;
      syncDockedPositions();
      applyGeometryAndScale();
      setStatusOverride(`SCALE: ${Math.round(STATE.uiScale * 100)}%`);
      saveState();
      renderAll();
      return;
    }
    if (inBox(x, y, 10, 55, 8, 10)) {
      STATE.avsOpen = !STATE.avsOpen;
      syncDockedPositions();
      applyGeometryAndScale();
      setStatusOverride('AVS VISUALIZER: ' + (STATE.avsOpen ? 'ON' : 'OFF'));
      saveState();
      renderAll();
      return;
    }

    if (inBox(x, y, 36, 26, 65, 13)) {
      STATE.timeleftmode = STATE.timeleftmode ? 0 : 1;
      setStatusOverride(STATE.timeleftmode ? 'TIME REMAINING' : 'TIME ELAPSED');
      saveState();
      renderMain();
      renderPledit();
      return;
    }

    if (inBox(x, y, 24, 43, 76, 16)) {
      STATE.saMode = (STATE.saMode + 1) % 7;
      const modeNames = [
        'VISUALIZER: OFF',
        'SPECTRUM ANALYZER',
        'FIRE SPECTRUM',
        'LINE SPECTRUM',
        'OSCILLOSCOPE WAVE',
        'DOT OSCILLOSCOPE',
        'STEREO VU METER'
      ];
      setStatusOverride(modeNames[STATE.saMode]);
      saveState();
      renderMain();
      return;
    }

    if (inBox(x, y, 107, 56, 68, 14)) {
      STATE.draggingAction = 'vol';
      const ratio = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (x - 114) / 51));
      ytmSetVolume(ratio * 255);
      renderMain();
      return;
    }

    if (inBox(x, y, 177, 56, 38, 14)) {
      STATE.draggingAction = 'bal';
      updateBalanceFromX(x);
      return;
    }

    if (inBox(x, y, 219, 58, 23, 12)) { STATE.pressedBtn = 'eq'; renderMain(); return; }
    if (inBox(x, y, 242, 58, 23, 12)) { STATE.pressedBtn = 'pl'; renderMain(); return; }

    if (inBox(x, y, 16, 70, 248, 14)) {
      STATE.draggingAction = 'pos';
      STATE.dragPosRatio = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (x - 30) / 219));
      const targetSec = STATE.dragPosRatio * (STATE.duration || 0);
      setStatusOverride(`SEEK TO: ${formatTimeSec(targetSec)}/${formatTimeSec(STATE.duration)} (${Math.round(STATE.dragPosRatio * 100)}%)`, 5000);
      renderMain();
      return;
    }

    if (inBox(x, y, 16, 88, 23, 18)) { STATE.pressedBtn = 'prev'; renderMain(); return; }
    if (inBox(x, y, 39, 88, 23, 18)) { STATE.pressedBtn = 'play'; renderMain(); return; }
    if (inBox(x, y, 62, 88, 23, 18)) { STATE.pressedBtn = 'pause'; renderMain(); return; }
    if (inBox(x, y, 85, 88, 23, 18)) { STATE.pressedBtn = 'stop'; renderMain(); return; }
    if (inBox(x, y, 108, 88, 22, 18)) { STATE.pressedBtn = 'next'; renderMain(); return; }
    if (inBox(x, y, 136, 89, 22, 16)) { STATE.pressedBtn = 'eject'; renderMain(); return; }

    if (inBox(x, y, 164, 89, 47, 15)) { STATE.pressedBtn = 'shuffle'; renderMain(); return; }
    if (inBox(x, y, 210, 89, 28, 15)) { STATE.pressedBtn = 'repeat'; renderMain(); return; }

    if (inBox(x, y, 250, 89, 20, 20)) {
      STATE.avsOpen = !STATE.avsOpen;
      lastQueueSignature = '';
      extractQueueFromYTM();
      syncDockedPositions();
      applyGeometryAndScale();
      setStatusOverride(STATE.avsOpen ? 'AVS VISUALIZER: ON' : 'AVS VISUALIZER: OFF');
      saveState();
      renderAll();
    }
  });

  mainCanvas.addEventListener('dblclick', (e) => {
    const { x, y } = getCanvasCoords(mainCanvas, e.clientX, e.clientY);
    if (y < 14 && x > 16 && x < 242) {
      toggleMainInPlaceCollapse();
    }
  });

  function updateBalanceFromX(x) {
    const raw = ((x - 184) / 24) * 254 - 127;
    STATE.pan = Math.abs(raw) < 18 ? 0 : Math.max(-127, Math.min(127, Math.round(raw)));
    updateAudioGraphParams();
    if (STATE.pan === 0) setStatusOverride('BALANCE: CENTER');
    else if (STATE.pan < 0) setStatusOverride(`BALANCE: ${Math.round((-STATE.pan / 127) * 100)}% LEFT`);
    else setStatusOverride(`BALANCE: ${Math.round((STATE.pan / 127) * 100)}% RIGHT`);
    renderMain();
  }

  // 2) Equalizer Penceresi Tıklamaları
  eqCanvas.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => {
    if (e.button !== 0) return;
    setActiveWin('eq');
    const { x, y } = getCanvasCoords(eqCanvas, e.clientX, e.clientY);
    if (inBox(x, y, 264, 3, 9, 9)) {
      STATE.eqOpen = false;
      syncDockedPositions();
      applyGeometryAndScale();
      saveState();
      renderAll();
      return;
    }
    if (y < 14) {
      startDragAction('move_eq', e);
      return;
    }
    if (inBox(x, y, 14, 18, 25, 12)) {
      STATE.eqEnabled = !STATE.eqEnabled;
      updateAudioGraphParams();
      setStatusOverride('EQ: ' + (STATE.eqEnabled ? 'ON' : 'OFF'));
      renderEq();
      return;
    }
    if (inBox(x, y, 39, 18, 33, 12)) {
      STATE.eqAuto = !STATE.eqAuto;
      renderEq();
      return;
    }
    const xCoords = [21, 78, 96, 114, 132, 150, 168, 186, 204, 222, 240];
    for (let i = 0; i < xCoords.length; i++) {
      if (inBox(x, y, xCoords[i], 38, 14, 63)) {
        STATE.draggingAction = i === 0 ? 'eq_preamp' : `eq_${i - 1}`;
        const val = Math.max(0, Math.min(63, Math.round(((y - 43) / 50) * 63)));
        if (i === 0) STATE.preamp = val;
        else STATE.eqBands[i - 1] = val;
        updateAudioGraphParams();
        renderEq();
        return;
      }
    }
  });

  // 3) Playlist Penceresi Tıklamaları
  pleditCanvas.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => {
    if (e.button !== 0) return;
    setActiveWin('pl');
    const { x, y } = getCanvasCoords(pleditCanvas, e.clientX, e.clientY);
    const W = STATE.plWidth;
    const H = STATE.plWindowshade ? 14 : STATE.plHeight;

    if (inBox(x, y, W - 21, 2, 10, 10)) {
      STATE.plWindowshade = !STATE.plWindowshade;
      applyGeometryAndScale();
      saveState();
      renderAll();
      return;
    }
    if (inBox(x, y, W - 11, 2, 10, 10)) {
      STATE.plOpen = false;
      applyGeometryAndScale();
      saveState();
      renderAll();
      return;
    }

    if (y < 14) {
      startDragAction('move_pl', e);
      return;
    }

    if (STATE.plWindowshade) return;

    if (inBox(x, y, W - 21, H - 20, 21, 20)) {
      startDragAction('resize_pl', e, { dir: 'se' });
      return;
    }

    if (STATE.activePopup) {
      handlePopupClick(STATE.activePopup, x, y);
      STATE.activePopup = null;
      renderPledit();
      return;
    }

    const listAreaH = H - 58;
    if (inBox(x, y, W - 19, 20, 16, listAreaH)) {
      STATE.draggingAction = 'plscroll';
      updatePlScrollFromY(y);
      return;
    }

    if (inBox(x, y, W - 19, H - 38, 16, 8)) {
      STATE.scrollOffset = Math.max(0, STATE.scrollOffset - 1);
      rebuildPlaylistDOM();
      renderPledit();
      return;
    }
    if (inBox(x, y, W - 19, H - 30, 16, 8)) {
      const maxScroll = Math.max(0, STATE.tracks.length - STATE.visibleRows);
      STATE.scrollOffset = Math.min(maxScroll, STATE.scrollOffset + 1);
      rebuildPlaylistDOM();
      renderPledit();
      return;
    }

    if (inBox(x, y, 14, H - 30, 22, 20)) { STATE.activePopup = 'ADD'; renderPledit(); return; }
    if (inBox(x, y, 43, H - 30, 22, 20)) { STATE.activePopup = 'REM'; renderPledit(); return; }
    if (inBox(x, y, 72, H - 30, 22, 20)) { STATE.activePopup = 'SEL'; renderPledit(); return; }
    if (inBox(x, y, 101, H - 30, 22, 20)) { STATE.activePopup = 'MISC'; renderPledit(); return; }
    if (inBox(x, y, W - 43, H - 30, 22, 20)) { STATE.activePopup = 'LIST'; renderPledit(); return; }

    if (inBox(x, y, W - 145, H - 18, 8, 12)) { ytmPrev(); return; }
    if (inBox(x, y, W - 137, H - 18, 9, 12)) { ytmPlay(); return; }
    if (inBox(x, y, W - 128, H - 18, 9, 12)) { ytmPause(); return; }
    if (inBox(x, y, W - 119, H - 18, 9, 12)) { ytmStop(); return; }
    if (inBox(x, y, W - 110, H - 18, 9, 12)) { ytmNext(); return; }
    if (inBox(x, y, W - 101, H - 18, 10, 12)) { openJumpModal(); return; }

    if (inBox(x, y, W - 87, H - 18, 35, 12)) {
      STATE.timeleftmode = STATE.timeleftmode ? 0 : 1;
      saveState();
      renderMain();
      renderPledit();
    }
  });

  pleditCanvas.addEventListener('dblclick', (e) => {
    const { x, y } = getCanvasCoords(pleditCanvas, e.clientX, e.clientY);
    if (y < 14 && x < STATE.plWidth - 25) {
      STATE.plWindowshade = !STATE.plWindowshade;
      applyGeometryAndScale();
      saveState();
      renderAll();
    }
  });

  // 4) AVS Penceresi Tıklamaları (Sol Tık: Sonraki Efekt, Sağ Tık / Sol Üst "AVS": Efekt Menüsü)
  avsCanvas.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => {
    setActiveWin('avs');
    const { x, y } = getCanvasCoords(avsCanvas, e.clientX, e.clientY);
    const W = STATE.avsWidth;
    const H = STATE.avsWindowshade ? 14 : STATE.avsHeight;

    if (e.button === 2) {
      e.preventDefault();
      openAvsPresetMenu();
      return;
    }
    if (e.button !== 0) return;

    if (inBox(x, y, 2, 2, 24, 11)) {
      openAvsPresetMenu();
      return;
    }
    if (inBox(x, y, W - 23, 2, 10, 10)) {
      STATE.avsWindowshade = !STATE.avsWindowshade;
      applyGeometryAndScale();
      saveState();
      renderAll();
      return;
    }
    if (inBox(x, y, W - 13, 2, 11, 11)) {
      STATE.avsOpen = false;
      applyGeometryAndScale();
      saveState();
      renderAll();
      return;
    }

    if (y < 14) {
      startDragAction('move_avs', e);
      return;
    }

    if (STATE.avsWindowshade) return;

    if (inBox(x, y, W - 18, H - 18, 18, 18)) {
      startDragAction('resize_avs', e, { dir: 'se' });
      return;
    }

    STATE.avsPreset = (STATE.avsPreset + 1) % AVS_PRESET_NAMES.length;
    STATE.avsPresetLabelUntil = performance.now() + 2400;
    avsBufCtx.fillStyle = '#000000';
    avsBufCtx.fillRect(0, 0, avsBufferCanvas.width, avsBufferCanvas.height);
    triggerAvsSongTransition(AVS_PRESET_NAMES[STATE.avsPreset], getCurrentSongLabel());
    saveState();
  });

  avsCanvas.addEventListener('contextmenu', (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    openAvsPresetMenu();
  });

  avsCanvas.addEventListener('dblclick', (e) => {
    const { x, y } = getCanvasCoords(avsCanvas, e.clientX, e.clientY);
    if (y < 14 && x > 24 && x < STATE.avsWidth - 25) {
      STATE.avsWindowshade = !STATE.avsWindowshade;
      applyGeometryAndScale();
      saveState();
      renderAll();
    }
  });

  function handlePopupClick(type, x, y) {
    const H = STATE.plHeight;
    if (type === 'ADD') {
      openJumpModal();
    } else if (type === 'REM') {
      if (y >= H - 100 && y < H - 82) {
        STATE.tracks = [];
        rebuildPlaylistDOM();
      } else if (y >= H - 64 && y < H - 46) {
        if (STATE.selectedIndex >= 0) {
          STATE.tracks.splice(STATE.selectedIndex, 1);
          STATE.tracks.forEach((t, idx) => { t.index = idx + 1; });
          rebuildPlaylistDOM();
        }
      }
    } else if (type === 'SEL') {
      if (y >= H - 82 && y < H - 64) {
        const nextSet = new Set();
        STATE.tracks.forEach((_, i) => { if (!STATE.selectedIndices.has(i)) nextSet.add(i); });
        STATE.selectedIndices = nextSet;
      } else if (y >= H - 64 && y < H - 46) {
        STATE.selectedIndices.clear();
        STATE.selectedIndex = -1;
      } else if (y >= H - 46 && y < H - 28) {
        STATE.tracks.forEach((_, i) => STATE.selectedIndices.add(i));
      }
      updatePlaylistDOMSelection();
    } else if (type === 'MISC') {
      if (y >= H - 82 && y < H - 64) {
        STATE.tracks.sort((a, b) => a.display.localeCompare(b.display, 'tr'));
        STATE.tracks.forEach((t, idx) => { t.index = idx + 1; });
        rebuildPlaylistDOM();
      } else {
        openJumpModal();
      }
    } else if (type === 'LIST') {
      lastQueueSignature = '';
      extractQueueFromYTM();
      setStatusOverride('QUEUE REFRESHED');
    }
  }

  function updatePlScrollFromY(y) {
    const listAreaH = STATE.plHeight - 58;
    const maxScroll = Math.max(0, STATE.tracks.length - STATE.visibleRows);
    const ratio = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (y - 29) / Math.max(1, listAreaH - 18)));
    const nextScroll = Math.round(ratio * maxScroll);
    if (nextScroll !== STATE.scrollOffset) {
      STATE.scrollOffset = nextScroll;
      rebuildPlaylistDOM();
    }
    renderPledit();
  }

  function openJumpModal() {
    jumpModal.style.display = 'flex';
    jumpInput.value = '';
    renderJumpResults('');
    setTimeout(() => jumpInput.focus(), 20);
  }

  function renderJumpResults(query) {
    while (jumpResults.firstChild) jumpResults.removeChild(jumpResults.firstChild);
    const q = query.trim().toLowerCase();
    STATE.tracks.forEach((tr, idx) => {
      if (q && !tr.display.toLowerCase().includes(q)) return;
      const item = document.createElement('div');
      item.className = 'wa-jump-item';
      item.textContent = `${tr.index}. ${tr.display} (${tr.durationStr})`;
      item.ondblclick = () => {
        jumpModal.style.display = 'none';
        playQueueTrackAtIndex(idx);
      };
      item.onclick = () => {
        jumpResults.querySelectorAll('.wa-jump-item').forEach((el) => el.classList.remove('wa-active'));
        item.classList.add('wa-active');
        item.dataset.idx = String(idx);
      };
      jumpResults.appendChild(item);
    });
  }

  jumpInput.addEventListener('input', () => renderJumpResults(jumpInput.value));
  jumpInput.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    if (e.key === 'Escape') {
      jumpModal.style.display = 'none';
    } else if (e.key === 'Enter') {
      const active = jumpResults.querySelector('.wa-jump-item.wa-active') || jumpResults.querySelector('.wa-jump-item');
      if (active) {
        const idx = parseInt(active.dataset.idx ?? '0', 10);
        jumpModal.style.display = 'none';
        playQueueTrackAtIndex(idx);
      } else {
        const ytmSearch = document.querySelector('ytmusic-search-box input');
        if (ytmSearch && jumpInput.value.trim()) {
          ytmSearch.value = jumpInput.value.trim();
          ytmSearch.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true }));
          ytmSearch.focus();
          jumpModal.style.display = 'none';
        }
      }
    }
  });

  function onGlobalMouseMove(e) {
    if (!STATE.draggingAction) return;

    const dx = e.screenX - dragStartX;
    const dy = e.screenY - dragStartY;

    if (STATE.draggingAction === 'move_main') {
      STATE.wx = Math.max(0, dragInit.wx + dx);
      STATE.wy = Math.max(0, dragInit.wy + dy);
      if (STATE.plDocked) {
        STATE.plX = dragInit.plX + dx;
        STATE.plY = dragInit.plY + dy;
      }
      if (STATE.eqDocked) {
        STATE.eqX = dragInit.eqX + dx;
        STATE.eqY = dragInit.eqY + dy;
      }
      if (STATE.avsDocked) {
        STATE.avsX = dragInit.avsX + dx;
        STATE.avsY = dragInit.avsY + dy;
      }
      applyGeometryAndScale();
      return;
    }

    if (STATE.draggingAction === 'move_pl') {
      const rawX = Math.max(0, dragInit.plX + dx);
      const rawY = Math.max(0, dragInit.plY + dy);
      const plR = getPlRect();
      const targets = [getMainRect()];
      if (STATE.eqOpen) targets.push(getEqRect());
      if (STATE.avsOpen) targets.push(getAvsRect());
      const snapped = snapWindowToTargets(rawX, rawY, plR.w, plR.h, targets);
      STATE.plX = snapped.x;
      STATE.plY = snapped.y;
      STATE.plDocked = snapped.docked;
      applyGeometryAndScale();
      return;
    }

    if (STATE.draggingAction === 'move_avs') {
      const rawX = Math.max(0, dragInit.avsX + dx);
      const rawY = Math.max(0, dragInit.avsY + dy);
      const avsR = getAvsRect();
      const targets = [getMainRect()];
      if (STATE.plOpen) targets.push(getPlRect());
      if (STATE.eqOpen) targets.push(getEqRect());
      const snapped = snapWindowToTargets(rawX, rawY, avsR.w, avsR.h, targets);
      STATE.avsX = snapped.x;
      STATE.avsY = snapped.y;
      STATE.avsDocked = snapped.docked;
      if (snapped.docked) STATE.avsDockSide = snapped.dockSide;
      applyGeometryAndScale();
      return;
    }

    if (STATE.draggingAction === 'move_eq') {
      const rawX = Math.max(0, dragInit.eqX + dx);
      const rawY = Math.max(0, dragInit.eqY + dy);
      const eqR = getEqRect();
      const targets = [getMainRect()];
      if (STATE.plOpen) targets.push(getPlRect());
      const snapped = snapWindowToTargets(rawX, rawY, eqR.w, eqR.h, targets);
      STATE.eqX = snapped.x;
      STATE.eqY = snapped.y;
      STATE.eqDocked = snapped.docked;
      applyGeometryAndScale();
      return;
    }

    if (STATE.draggingAction === 'resize_scale') {
      const vp = getActiveViewport();
      const maxAllowedW = Math.max(245, vp.w - STATE.wx);
      const newWidthPx = Math.max(245, Math.min(maxAllowedW, 275 * dragInit.uiScale + dx));
      STATE.uiScale = newWidthPx / 275;
      syncDockedPositions();
      applyGeometryAndScale();
      setStatusOverride(`HD SCALE: ${Math.round(STATE.uiScale * 100)}%`, 800);
      renderAll();
      return;
    }

    if (STATE.draggingAction === 'resize_pl') {
      const dir = dragInit.dir || 'se';
      const vp = getActiveViewport();
      if (dir.includes('e')) {
        const maxW = Math.floor((vp.w - STATE.plX) / STATE.uiScale);
        STATE.plWidth = Math.max(275, Math.min(maxW, Math.round(dragInit.plW + dx / STATE.uiScale)));
      }
      if (dir.includes('s')) {
        const maxH = Math.floor((vp.h - STATE.plY) / STATE.uiScale);
        STATE.plHeight = Math.max(154, Math.min(maxH, Math.round(dragInit.plH + dy / STATE.uiScale)));
      }
      applyGeometryAndScale();
      renderPledit();
      return;
    }

    if (STATE.draggingAction === 'resize_avs') {
      const dir = dragInit.dir || 'se';
      const vp = getActiveViewport();
      if (dir.includes('e')) {
        const maxW = Math.floor((vp.w - STATE.avsX) / STATE.uiScale);
        STATE.avsWidth = Math.max(220, Math.min(maxW, Math.round(dragInit.avsW + dx / STATE.uiScale)));
      }
      if (dir.includes('s')) {
        const maxH = Math.floor((vp.h - STATE.avsY) / STATE.uiScale);
        STATE.avsHeight = Math.max(140, Math.min(maxH, Math.round(dragInit.avsH + dy / STATE.uiScale)));
      }
      applyGeometryAndScale();
      renderAvs();
      return;
    }

    if (STATE.draggingAction === 'vol') {
      const { x } = getCanvasCoords(mainCanvas, e.clientX, e.clientY);
      const ratio = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (x - 114) / 51));
      ytmSetVolume(ratio * 255);
      renderMain();
      return;
    }

    if (STATE.draggingAction === 'bal') {
      const { x } = getCanvasCoords(mainCanvas, e.clientX, e.clientY);
      updateBalanceFromX(x);
      return;
    }

    if (STATE.draggingAction === 'pos') {
      const { x } = getCanvasCoords(mainCanvas, e.clientX, e.clientY);
      STATE.dragPosRatio = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (x - 30) / 219));
      const targetSec = STATE.dragPosRatio * (STATE.duration || 0);
      setStatusOverride(`SEEK TO: ${formatTimeSec(targetSec)}/${formatTimeSec(STATE.duration)} (${Math.round(STATE.dragPosRatio * 100)}%)`, 5000);
      renderMain();
      return;
    }

    if (STATE.draggingAction === 'plscroll') {
      const { y } = getCanvasCoords(pleditCanvas, e.clientX, e.clientY);
      updatePlScrollFromY(y);
      return;
    }

    if (STATE.draggingAction && STATE.draggingAction.startsWith('eq_')) {
      const { y } = getCanvasCoords(eqCanvas, e.clientX, e.clientY);
      const val = Math.max(0, Math.min(63, Math.round(((y - 43) / 50) * 63)));
      if (STATE.draggingAction === 'eq_preamp') STATE.preamp = val;
      else {
        const bIdx = parseInt(STATE.draggingAction.split('_')[1], 10);
        if (!isNaN(bIdx)) STATE.eqBands[bIdx] = val;
      }
      updateAudioGraphParams();
      renderEq();
    }
  }

  function onGlobalMouseUp() {
    if (STATE.draggingAction === 'pos') {
      const targetSec = STATE.dragPosRatio * (STATE.duration || 0);
      ytmSeekTo(targetSec);
      STATE.overrideUntil = 0;
    } else if (STATE.draggingAction) {
      saveState();
    }
    STATE.draggingAction = null;

    if (STATE.pressedBtn) {
      const btn = STATE.pressedBtn;
      STATE.pressedBtn = null;
      if (btn === 'prev') ytmPrev();
      else if (btn === 'play') ytmPlay();
      else if (btn === 'pause') ytmPause();
      else if (btn === 'stop') ytmStop();
      else if (btn === 'next') ytmNext();
      else if (btn === 'eject') openJumpModal();
      else if (btn === 'shuffle') ytmToggleShuffle();
      else if (btn === 'repeat') ytmToggleRepeat();
      else if (btn === 'eq') {
        STATE.eqOpen = !STATE.eqOpen;
        syncDockedPositions();
        applyGeometryAndScale();
        saveState();
      } else if (btn === 'pl') {
        STATE.plOpen = !STATE.plOpen;
        syncDockedPositions();
        applyGeometryAndScale();
        saveState();
      } else if (btn === 'tb_min' || btn === 'tb_shade' || btn === 'tb_close') {
        toggleMainInPlaceCollapse();
      }
    }
    renderAll();
  }

  function attachWindowEvents(targetWin) {
    targetWin.addEventListener('mousemove', onGlobalMouseMove);
    targetWin.addEventListener('mouseup', onGlobalMouseUp);
    targetWin.addEventListener('resize', () => {
      syncDockedPositions();
      applyGeometryAndScale();
      renderAll();
    });
    targetWin.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
      const tag = (e.target && e.target.tagName) ? e.target.tagName.toLowerCase() : '';
      if (tag === 'input' || tag === 'textarea' || e.target?.isContentEditable) return;
      if (e.altKey && e.key.toLowerCase() === 'e') {
        e.preventDefault();
        STATE.plOpen = !STATE.plOpen;
        applyGeometryAndScale();
        saveState();
        renderAll();
      } else if (e.altKey && e.key.toLowerCase() === 'g') {
        e.preventDefault();
        STATE.eqOpen = !STATE.eqOpen;
        applyGeometryAndScale();
        saveState();
        renderAll();
      } else if (e.altKey && e.key.toLowerCase() === 'v') {
        e.preventDefault();
        STATE.avsOpen = !STATE.avsOpen;
        applyGeometryAndScale();
        saveState();
        renderAll();
      } else if (e.key === 'F3') {
        e.preventDefault();
        openJumpModal();
      } else if (e.key === 'Enter' && STATE.selectedIndex >= 0) {
        playQueueTrackAtIndex(STATE.selectedIndex);
      }
    });
  }

  attachWindowEvents(window);

  let lastQueueCheck = 0;

  function tick(now) {
    syncPlayerStateFromYTM();

    if (now - STATE.lastMarqueeTick > 42) {
      STATE.marqueeOffset += 1;
      STATE.lastMarqueeTick = now;
    }

    if (now - lastQueueCheck > 600) {
      extractQueueFromYTM();
      lastQueueCheck = now;
    }

    updateVisualizerData(now);
    renderMain();
    if (!STATE.windowshade) {
      if (STATE.plOpen) renderPledit();
      if (STATE.avsOpen) renderAvs(now);
    }
    requestAnimationFrame(tick);
  }

  const observer = new MutationObserver(() => {
    extractQueueFromYTM();
  });
  observer.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });

  syncDockedPositions();
  clampAllWindowsToViewport();
  applyGeometryAndScale();
  extractQueueFromYTM();
  requestAnimationFrame(tick);
})();
